keys: My sister lives there. She bakes the most delicious cookies! The flour I get is shipped from her bakery.
en: My sister lives there. She bakes the most delicious cookies! The flour I get is shipped from her bakery.
zh: 我妹妹就住在那儿。她烤的饼干最好吃！我收的面粉就是从她的面包房运来的。

keys: A delivery arrived at the docks this morning, but walking back and forth in this heat is exhausting.
en: A delivery arrived at the docks this morning, but walking back and forth in this heat is exhausting.
zh: 今天早上码头到了一批货，但这鬼天气来回跑一趟真是累人。

keys: Ah, welcome! I'm afraid the shelves are empty at the moment.
en: Ah, welcome! I'm afraid the shelves are empty at the moment.
zh: 啊，欢迎！可惜货架现在空着呢。

keys: Any luck at the docks? Look for barrels marked with a blue seal.
en: Any luck at the docks? Look for barrels marked with a blue seal.
zh: 码头有收获吗？找带蓝色蜡封的桶。

keys: But grain? Tonori has never been the place to grow grain. Without the trade ships, this city would go hungry.
en: But grain? Tonori has never been the place to grow grain. Without the trade ships, this city would go hungry.
zh: 可粮食呢？托诺里从来不是产粮的地方。没有商船，全城都得挨饿。

keys: Cactus, mostly. Hardy plants, and we make good use of them. Candy, drinks, even medicine.
en: Cactus, mostly. Hardy plants, and we make good use of them. Candy, drinks, even medicine.
zh: 大多是仙人掌。这种植物很皮实，我们把它用了个遍：糖果、饮料，甚至药材。

keys: Even in this heat, a warm loaf of bread is hard to pass on.
en: Even in this heat, a warm loaf of bread is hard to pass on.
zh: 这么热的天，一块热面包还是让人难以拒绝。

keys: Free up some space and come back.
en: Free up some space and come back.
zh: 腾点地方再回来吧。

keys: Great port city across the ocean, on the Aurora coast. Rich farmland, skilled artisans.
en: Great port city across the ocean, on the Aurora coast. Rich farmland, skilled artisans.
zh: 大洋彼岸的良港，就在欧若拉海岸。沃野千里，能工巧匠云集。

keys: Have you checked the docks? The flour sacks should be inside the barrel with the blue seal.
en: Have you checked the docks? The flour sacks should be inside the barrel with the blue seal.
zh: 码头找过了吗？面粉袋应该在带蓝色蜡封的桶里。

keys: Here, take some of my best. Croissants and cactus candy. One is a family recipe and the other one is a specialty of Tulimshar!
en: Here, take some of my best. Croissants and cactus candy. One is a family recipe and the other one is a specialty of Tulimshar!
zh: 来，拿点我最拿手的。羊角包和仙人掌糖，一个是家传配方，另一个是图利姆沙尔的特产！

keys: I have my flour shipped in from Artis to keep my bakery running. My Sandstorm Bread has fed this city for many years.
en: I have my flour shipped in from Artis to keep my bakery running. My Sandstorm Bread has fed this city for many years.
zh: 我的面粉都是从阿蒂斯运来的，面包房才开得下去。我的沙暴面包养活了这座城市很多年。

keys: I'll have the ovens hot and ready.
en: I'll have the ovens hot and ready.
zh: 我会把烤炉预热好的。

keys: If I go myself, I'll be too tired to bake anything today.
en: If I go myself, I'll be too tired to bake anything today.
zh: 要是我自己去，今天就没力气烤面包了。

keys: It also keeps us fed, but for a business like mine it means always waiting on the next ship to come in.
en: It also keeps us fed, but for a business like mine it means always waiting on the next ship to come in.
zh: 这也养活了我们。不过对我这样的买卖来说，就意味着永远在等下一班船进港。

keys: Look for the deep blue seal. You can't miss it.
en: Look for the deep blue seal. You can't miss it.
zh: 找深蓝色蜡封就行，一眼就能认出来。

keys: Much appreciated, friend.
en: Much appreciated, friend.
zh: 感激不尽，朋友。

keys: My signature recipe! Flour from Artis, cactus juice instead of regular water and a pinch of desert salt.
en: My signature recipe! Flour from Artis, cactus juice instead of regular water and a pinch of desert salt.
zh: 我的招牌配方！阿蒂斯面粉，用仙人掌汁代替清水，再加一撮沙漠盐。

keys: No trouble. The ovens will wait, then.
en: No trouble. The ovens will wait, then.
zh: 没关系，烤炉可以先等等。

keys: Stop by anytime. There's always a fresh loaf waiting.
en: Stop by anytime. There's always a fresh loaf waiting.
zh: 随时来坐坐。总有新鲜面包等着你。

keys: The barrels from the Artis bakery are marked by a blue wax seal. Could you bring me the flour bags that are inside?
en: The barrels from the Artis bakery are marked by a blue wax seal. Could you bring me the flour bags that are inside?
zh: 阿蒂斯面包房的桶上有蓝色蜡封。你能帮我把里面的面粉袋带回来吗？

keys: The crust holds through sandstorms and still tastes fresh the next morning. That's how it earned the name.
en: The crust holds through sandstorms and still tastes fresh the next morning. That's how it earned the name.
zh: 这种面包皮扛得住沙暴，第二天早上依然新鲜。名字就是这么来的。

keys: The merchant ships from Artis keep half of Tulimshar's market stocked. Without them, we'd have little more than cactus to eat.
en: The merchant ships from Artis keep half of Tulimshar's market stocked. Without them, we'd have little more than cactus to eat.
zh: 阿蒂斯的商船养活了图利姆沙尔半个集市。没有它们，我们除了仙人掌几乎没别的可吃。

keys: Trading. It has always been Tulimshar's greatest skill. How else does a city like this thrive in a windy desert valley?
en: Trading. It has always been Tulimshar's greatest skill. How else does a city like this thrive in a windy desert valley?
zh: 做生意。这从来都是图利姆沙尔最大的本事。不然这样一座城怎么能在风沙河谷里活下来？

keys: Tulimshar doesn't have any good farmland. As you can see around you, we're in a desert. Nothing grows out here but cactus.
en: Tulimshar doesn't have any good farmland. As you can see around you, we're in a desert. Nothing grows out here but cactus.
zh: 图利姆沙尔没有像样的农田。看看四周就明白，我们身在沙漠里，除了仙人掌什么都不长。

keys: We sit at the crossroads of three continents. Everything passes through Tulimshar's port sooner or later.
en: We sit at the crossroads of three continents. Everything passes through Tulimshar's port sooner or later.
zh: 我们坐拥三大洲的十字路口。所有货物流转迟早都要经过图利姆沙尔的港口。

keys: With this flour, Tulimshar will have fresh Sandstorm Bread by sundown.
en: With this flour, Tulimshar will have fresh Sandstorm Bread by sundown.
zh: 有了这些面粉，日落前全城就能吃上新鲜的沙暴面包了。

keys: You found them! But it looks like your bag is too full for me to give you anything in return.
en: You found them! But it looks like your bag is too full for me to give you anything in return.
zh: 你找到了！不过你的包看起来太满了，我没法再塞报酬给你。

keys: You found them! Wonderful.
en: You found them! Wonderful.
zh: 你找到了！太好了。

keys: %d bottles. Don't break them, they're fine Eridu glass!
en: %d bottles. Don't break them, they're fine Eridu glass!
zh: %d个瓶子。别打破了，这可是上好的埃利都玻璃！

keys: %d bottles. Try not to break them!
en: %d bottles. Try not to break them!
zh: %d个瓶子。尽量别打破！

keys: ...Sorry. That region just irritates me.
en: ...Sorry. That region just irritates me.
zh: ……抱歉。那片地方就是让我心烦。

keys: A Kano, a Mana Seed.
en: A Kano, a Mana Seed.
zh: 卡诺，一颗魔力种子。

keys: A calm voice fills your head.
en: A calm voice fills your head.
zh: 一个平静的声音在你脑海中响起。

keys: A croissant! I cannot believe it. You are truly too kind, I did not expect this at all!
en: A croissant! I cannot believe it. You are truly too kind, I did not expect this at all!
zh: 一个牛角面包！真是难以置信。你实在太好了，我完全没想到！

keys: A deep blue wax seal stamped with the Artis crest. This is the one.
en: A deep blue wax seal stamped with the Artis crest. This is the one.
zh: 一枚深蓝色的火漆印章，盖着阿蒂斯的纹章。就是这枚。

keys: A draw! Evenly matched. That doesn't happen often at my table.
en: A draw! Evenly matched. That doesn't happen often at my table.
zh: 平局！势均力敌。在我这牌桌上可不常有这种事。

keys: A few days ago I decided to confront the desert and explore this area.
en: A few days ago I decided to confront the desert and explore this area.
zh: 几天前，我决定直面沙漠，探索这片区域。

keys: A strange sensasion passes through you. Like flowing water, but not wet. The stone briefly pulsates with a faint blue light.
en: A strange sensasion passes through you. Like flowing water, but not wet. The stone briefly pulsates with a faint blue light.
zh: 一种奇异的感觉掠过你的全身。像流水一样，却不湿。石碑短暂地闪烁着微弱的蓝光。

keys: A tie at %d! You've got guts, I'll give you that.
en: A tie at %d! You've got guts, I'll give you that.
zh: 打成 %d 平！你胆子不小，这点我承认。

keys: A tree. A magical tree. A magical TALKING tree.
en: A tree. A magical tree. A magical TALKING tree.
zh: 一棵树。一棵魔法树。一棵会说话的魔法树。

keys: ARGH.
en: ARGH.

keys: Actually... there might be.
en: Actually... there might be.
zh: 其实……说不定有。

keys: Agility affects how fast and far you can attack and how well you can dodge an attack.
en: Agility affects how fast and far you can attack and how well you can dodge an attack.
zh: 敏捷影响你攻击的速度和距离，以及躲避攻击的能力。

keys: Ah, I see.
en: Ah, I see.
zh: 啊，我明白了。

keys: Aim, shoot and block your ears as they do some nasty sounds when you hit them.
en: Aim, shoot and block your ears as they do some nasty sounds when you hit them.
zh: 瞄准，射击，然后捂住耳朵——打中它们的时候声音可难听了。

keys: All I have to do is to prevent people from bothering our queen while she works on her garden.
en: All I have to do is to prevent people from bothering our queen while she works on her garden.
zh: 我要做的就是不让人打扰我们的女王，她正在打理她的花园。

keys: All the others I picked up over time. People whose attitude I like. Everyone on board is with me for a reason.
en: All the others I picked up over time. People whose attitude I like. Everyone on board is with me for a reason.
zh: 其他人都是我一路结识的。我欣赏他们的人品。船上的每个人都有他跟着我的理由。

keys: Alright, but you won't get a better deal anywhere else!
en: Alright, but you won't get a better deal anywhere else!
zh: 行吧，但你在别处可找不到更划算的价钱了！

keys: Alright, let's see who else is brave enough. Hang tight.
en: Alright, let's see who else is brave enough. Hang tight.
zh: 好，看看还有谁有胆子来。稍等一下。

keys: Although I would like to see it, I do not need the Sun's light to live.
en: Although I would like to see it, I do not need the Sun's light to live.
zh: 虽然我也想看看，但没有太阳的光，我照样能活。

keys: And I'm showing: %s.
en: And I'm showing: %s.
zh: 我现在出的是：%s。

keys: And he just did things. Decided things. Without telling me, without telling anyone. I'd find out after the fact.
en: And he just did things. Decided things. Without telling me, without telling anyone. I'd find out after the fact.
zh: 而他就直接动手做事。自己拿主意。不告诉我，也不告诉任何人。我总是事后才知道。

keys: And if the whole board fills up and nobody won, it's a tie. Those are boring though.
en: And if the whole board fills up and nobody won, it's a tie. Those are boring though.
zh: 如果整个棋盘都满了却没人赢，那就是平局。不过平局很无聊。

keys: And if you are in danger, remember to run away, there is no pride in being dead.
en: And if you are in danger, remember to run away, there is no pride in being dead.
zh: 要是遇到危险，记得逃命，死了可没什么骄傲可言。

keys: And stay out of the light. The guards are on strict orders to escort any unauthorised citizens out.
en: And stay out of the light. The guards are on strict orders to escort any unauthorised citizens out.
zh: 还有，别待在亮处。守卫接到严令，要把任何未经许可的市民护送出去。

keys: And tell him the walls still stand. He'll... Yeah. Tell him that.
en: And tell him the walls still stand. He'll... Yeah. Tell him that.
zh: 告诉他城墙依然矗立。他会……嗯。就这么告诉他。

keys: Another reason for her to keep magic away from her people. The Zuni still practice their ancient magic and it makes them very hard to fight.
en: Another reason for her to keep magic away from her people. The Zuni still practice their ancient magic and it makes them very hard to fight.
zh: 这也是她不让族人接触魔法的又一个原因。祖尼人仍在修炼他们的古老魔法，这让他们非常难对付。

keys: Anyway, enough chatting. I need you to get in this field and clean away this mess!
en: Anyway, enough chatting. I need you to get in this field and clean away this mess!
zh: 好了，闲聊到此为止。我需要你到田里去，把这些乱七八糟的东西清理干净！

keys: Anyway, here are some basic clothes to replace the rags we found you in.
en: Anyway, here are some basic clothes to replace the rags we found you in.
zh: 总之，这里有些基本的衣服，换掉我们捡到你时你身上那些破烂吧。

keys: Anyway. I told him to leave. He left. End of story.
en: Anyway. I told him to leave. He left. End of story.
zh: 总之。我让他离开。他走了。就这样。

keys: Apart from the sand storm that blows through the valley, this area is relatively safe compared to farther parts of Tonori where all sorts of dangers hide among the hot sands.
en: Apart from the sand storm that blows through the valley, this area is relatively safe compared to farther parts of Tonori where all sorts of dangers hide among the hot sands.
zh: 除了穿过山谷的沙暴，比起托诺里更深处那些藏着各种危险灼热沙地，这片区域算是相对安全的。

keys: Are you lost?
en: Are you lost?
zh: 你迷路了吗？

keys: As chance has dictated, you are now a warden of a powerful Source of Mana.
en: As chance has dictated, you are now a warden of a powerful Source of Mana.
zh: 机缘所定，如今你成了一处强大魔力之源的守护者。

keys: As long as I can connect to its flow, I am alive.
en: As long as I can connect to its flow, I am alive.
zh: 只要我还能与魔力之流相连，我就活着。

keys: As usual she didn't even consider the danger it poses to the people she wants to send there to work.
en: As usual she didn't even consider the danger it poses to the people she wants to send there to work.
zh: 跟往常一样，她根本没考虑过这对其要派去干活的人有多危险。

keys: As you can see I already have some sorry beggars here who are desperate enough to dig through the dirt and see if there's any valuable metals left in this miserable place.
en: As you can see I already have some sorry beggars here who are desperate enough to dig through the dirt and see if there's any valuable metals left in this miserable place.
zh: 如你所见，这里已经有几个可怜的家伙了，他们穷困潦倒，只能在这破地方刨土，看看还能不能挖出点值钱的金属。

keys: At least now I'm sure we won't be going down there. First person I send died. Not a good sign.
en: At least now I'm sure we won't be going down there. First person I send died. Not a good sign.
zh: 至少现在我能确定我们不会下那儿去了。我派下去的第一个人死了。可不是个好兆头。

keys: At the far end of the western wall corridor near us, past Ben's patrols, there's a small chamber with a library shelf.
en: At the far end of the western wall corridor near us, past Ben's patrols, there's a small chamber with a library shelf.
zh: 在西墙走廊我们这头尽头，过了本的巡逻范围，有个小房间，里面有一个图书馆书架。

keys: Avoid telling anyone else about this for now. This is a very powerful item. Something that will surely attract the wrong attention.
en: Avoid telling anyone else about this for now. This is a very powerful item. Something that will surely attract the wrong attention.
zh: 暂时别告诉任何人。这是一件非常强大的物品。肯定会招来不该有的注意。

keys: Back before the Age of Kaore, hundreds of years ago, some creatures of this world were not as... Strange as they are today.
en: Back before the Age of Kaore, hundreds of years ago, some creatures of this world were not as... Strange as they are today.
zh: 在卡奥尔之纪之前的几百年前，世界上有些生物还不像今天这样……怪异。

keys: Back for some glass? Good to see you.
en: Back for some glass? Good to see you.
zh: 回来取玻璃了？很高兴见到你。

keys: Bah! Even an old master overreaches sometimes. Well played.
en: Bah! Even an old master overreaches sometimes. Well played.
zh: 呸！老高手也有失手的时候。打得好。

keys: Be careful. What you have discovered here today has been hidden for thousands of years.
en: Be careful. What you have discovered here today has been hidden for thousands of years.
zh: 小心点。你今天在这里发现的东西，已经尘封了几千年。

keys: Be sure to talk to Elanore, she took care of you while you were passed out after we found you.
en: Be sure to talk to Elanore, she took care of you while you were passed out after we found you.
zh: 一定要去找埃兰诺聊聊，我们找到你的时候你昏迷不醒，是她一直照顾你。

keys: Be warned: insults are not welcomed here, just so you know. We look after each other in this city.
en: Be warned: insults are not welcomed here, just so you know. We look after each other in this city.
zh: 提醒你一句：这里不欢迎出言不逊的人，先说清楚。这座城里我们互相照应。

keys: Beat me, and I'll tip my hat. Go over 21, and you bust. That's the game.
en: Beat me, and I'll tip my hat. Go over 21, and you bust. That's the game.
zh: 赢了我，我就脱帽致敬。超过21点，你就爆了。规则就是这样。

keys: Before I let you go, allow me to walk you through a few things that will help keep you alive out there.
en: Before I let you go, allow me to walk you through a few things that will help keep you alive out there.
zh: 放你走之前，请允许我先给你讲几件事，好让你在外头活下去。

keys: Before you go, take this.
en: Before you go, take this.
zh: 你走之前，带上这个。

keys: Being stationed in this inner wall section is the best thing you could expect.
en: Being stationed in this inner wall section is the best thing you could expect.
zh: 驻守内墙这一段，是你能盼到的最好差事了。

keys: Ben looks through the letters, shifting them in his hands.
en: Ben looks through the letters, shifting them in his hands.
zh: 本翻看着那些信，在手里翻来翻去。

keys: Ben saw it differently. Said I was piling even more pressure on top of what we were already under.
en: Ben saw it differently. Said I was piling even more pressure on top of what we were already under.
zh: 本却不这么看。他说我是在我们本就承受的压力上又加了一层。

keys: Beyond this point lies the throne room of the Red Queen herself. Turn back now.
en: Beyond this point lies the throne room of the Red Queen herself. Turn back now.
zh: 过了这里就是红发女王本人的王座厅。请回吧。

keys: Blackjack!
en: Blackjack!
zh: 二十一点！

keys: Bones will need to come from the reanimated corpses that wander certain areas. I've heard they're created by Kaore. Certainly better than digging into graves.
en: Bones will need to come from the reanimated corpses that wander certain areas. I've heard they're created by Kaore. Certainly better than digging into graves.
zh: 骨头得从某些区域游荡的不死复生尸骸身上取。听说它们是卡奥尔造出来的。总比去刨坟墓强。

keys: Bring him back if he's alive. If he's dead, then you will probably die as well and we will know there's danger down there.
en: Bring him back if he's alive. If he's dead, then you will probably die as well and we will know there's danger down there.
zh: 他要是活着，就把他带回来。他要是死了，那你多半也会死，我们就知道下面有危险了。

keys: Bring me more materials any time. %d of each, and I will blow some more glass for you.
en: Bring me more materials any time. %d of each, and I will blow some more glass for you.
zh: 随时再给我带材料来。每种%d份，我就再为你吹些玻璃。

keys: Bring the sealed letters to Ben. I just saw him walk into the corridor as soon as you left.
en: Bring the sealed letters to Ben. I just saw him walk into the corridor as soon as you left.
zh: 把封好的信交给本。你刚走我就看见他进了那条走廊。

keys: Bring them here and I will put %d bottles in your hands before they have finished cooling.
en: Bring them here and I will put %d bottles in your hands before they have finished cooling.
zh: 把它们带到这儿来，趁玻璃还没冷却，我就能把%d个瓶子交到你手上。

keys: Bust! Should've listened to your gut.
en: Bust! Should've listened to your gut.
zh: 爆了！就该听你直觉的。

keys: But I should not keep you here all day. You are new to the city and will want to find your footing.
en: But I should not keep you here all day. You are new to the city and will want to find your footing.
zh: 不过我不该让你在这儿耗一整天。你刚来这座城市，总得先熟悉环境。

keys: But before everything I should tell you something.
en: But before everything I should tell you something.
zh: 但在这之前，我得先跟你说点事。

keys: But before you go, you can't cross the desert barefoot and half-blind.
en: But before you go, you can't cross the desert barefoot and half-blind.
zh: 不过你走之前——光着脚、半瞎着穿过沙漠可不行。

keys: But don't you worry about that right now. We can chat more later. Right now I am just out here giving a hand with potions and receiving the injured from outside the walls.
en: But don't you worry about that right now. We can chat more later. Right now I am just out here giving a hand with potions and receiving the injured from outside the walls.
zh: 但这个你现在不用担心。我们以后再聊。我现在只是在这儿帮忙配药，接收城墙外送来的伤员。

keys: But one more thing. Before you leave the city, have a word with Gilgames over there. He is guarding the gate and is always willing to speak with new recruits.
en: But one more thing. Before you leave the city, have a word with Gilgames over there. He is guarding the gate and is always willing to speak with new recruits.
zh: 不过还有一件事。出城之前，去找那边的吉尔伽美什说句话。他守着城门，总是乐意和新兵聊聊。

keys: But then, she still uses it in her palace. She only means that it's better for the common people to not have it, claims that it's too dangerous.
en: But then, she still uses it in her palace. She only means that it's better for the common people to not have it, claims that it's too dangerous.
zh: 可话又说回来，她自己还在王宫里用着。她只是觉得普通人最好别碰魔法，声称太危险了。

keys: But watch out, you will lose some water along the way if one of those snakes bites you!
en: But watch out, you will lose some water along the way if one of those snakes bites you!
zh: 但小心点，要是被那些蛇咬了，你一路上会漏掉不少水！

keys: But your bag is too full to carry them.
en: But your bag is too full to carry them.
zh: 但你的背包太满，装不下了。

keys: Cacti are coming in nicely this year.
en: Cacti are coming in nicely this year.
zh: 今年的仙人掌长势不错。

keys: Can you draw a perfect circle? I can! My dad taught me.
en: Can you draw a perfect circle? I can! My dad taught me.
zh: 你能画出完美的圆吗？我能！我爸爸教的。

keys: Candor to the north, the Manayir coast west from here, or all the way to Artis on the north-east.
en: Candor to the north, the Manayir coast west from here, or all the way to Artis on the north-east.
zh: 北边是坎多，往西是玛纳伊尔海岸，或者一路往东北走到阿蒂斯。

keys: Careful where you step. The cacti are just coming in.
en: Careful where you step. The cacti are just coming in.
zh: 脚下留神。仙人掌刚长出来。

keys: Clue 1
en: Clue 1
zh: 线索一

keys: Clue 2
en: Clue 2
zh: 线索二

keys: Clue 3
en: Clue 3
zh: 线索三

keys: Clue 4
en: Clue 4
zh: 线索四

keys: Clue 5
en: Clue 5
zh: 线索五

keys: Come back any time.
en: Come back any time.
zh: 随时回来。

keys: Come back when you've got something to show me. I have work to do.
en: Come back when you've got something to show me. I have work to do.
zh: 等你拿出点东西再来见我。我还有活要干。

keys: Come on, go inside. They must be waiting for you.
en: Come on, go inside. They must be waiting for you.
zh: 快进去吧。他们肯定在等你。

keys: Completing an objective, fighting or taking part in activities will help you grow. Look around and don't be afraid to talk to people around you nor to explore surrounding areas.
en: Completing an objective, fighting or taking part in activities will help you grow. Look around and don't be afraid to talk to people around you nor to explore surrounding areas.
zh: 完成任务、战斗或参加活动都能让你成长。四处看看，别怕跟周围的人搭话，也别怕探索周边的区域。

keys: Concentration feeds your mana and permits you to reach peak performance from your skills.
en: Concentration feeds your mana and permits you to reach peak performance from your skills.
zh: 专注滋养你的魔力，让你的技能发挥出巅峰水准。

keys: Congratulation for getting this far and thank you for being part of this journey with us!
en: Congratulation for getting this far and thank you for being part of this journey with us!
zh: 恭喜你走到这里，也感谢你与我们一同踏上这段旅程！

keys: Councillor Bones' orders. Nobody walks these corridors without clearance.
en: Councillor Bones' orders. Nobody walks these corridors without clearance.
zh: 邦斯议员的命令。没有通行许可，谁也不许走这些走廊。

keys: Did you find Ben? He's in the western wall corridor.
en: Did you find Ben? He's in the western wall corridor.
zh: 找到本了吗？他在西墙走廊。

keys: Did you manage to find a bottle of water?
en: Did you manage to find a bottle of water?
zh: 你找到水瓶了吗？

keys: Did you take care of those maggots?
en: Did you take care of those maggots?
zh: 那些蛆虫你清理了吗？

keys: Disgusting creatures. They say that in the past they used to be smaller.
en: Disgusting creatures. They say that in the past they used to be smaller.
zh: 恶心的生物。据说它们以前要小得多。

keys: Do we have a deal?
en: Do we have a deal?
zh: 成交吗？

keys: Do you ever run the same scenario over and over in your head and wonder how different things would be if you took a different decision?
en: Do you ever run the same scenario over and over in your head and wonder how different things would be if you took a different decision?
zh: 你有没有在脑子里反复回想某个场景，想着如果当时做了不同的决定，一切会多么不同？

keys: Do you have anything on you that could help?
en: Do you have anything on you that could help?
zh: 你身上有什么能帮上忙的东西吗？

keys: Do you know a game called blackjack? I happen to be the inventor of it!
en: Do you know a game called blackjack? I happen to be the inventor of it!
zh: 你听说过一种叫二十一点的牌戏吗？我碰巧就是发明它的人！

keys: Do you know where you're going?
en: Do you know where you're going?
zh: 你知道自己要去哪儿吗？

keys: Do you think you could give it a try? I am so tired. I will need at least one full jug to journey back to the city.
en: Do you think you could give it a try? I am so tired. I will need at least one full jug to journey back to the city.
zh: 你能试试吗？我实在累坏了。我至少需要满满一壶水才能走回城里。

keys: Do you want to play tic-tac-toe?
en: Do you want to play tic-tac-toe?
zh: 你想玩井字棋吗？

keys: Do you want to play tic-tac-toe? I drew the board myself!
en: Do you want to play tic-tac-toe? I drew the board myself!
zh: 你想玩井字棋吗？棋盘是我自己画的！

keys: Don't bother me.
en: Don't bother me.
zh: 别烦我。

keys: Don't go around saying I told you that, though.
en: Don't go around saying I told you that, though.
zh: 不过别到处说是我告诉你的。

keys: Each hit costs stamina. Run out and your attacks will have less effect.
en: Each hit costs stamina. Run out and your attacks will have less effect.
zh: 每次挥击都要消耗体力。体力耗尽，你的攻击就会大打折扣。

keys: Endurance helps your stamina last longer, regenerate faster and lets you land another hit sooner.
en: Endurance helps your stamina last longer, regenerate faster and lets you land another hit sooner.
zh: 耐力让你的体力更持久、恢复更快，还能让你更快地打出下一击。

keys: Eridu laughs.
en: Eridu laughs.
zh: 埃利都大笑。

keys: Even the guards could learn this one, and that's saying something.
en: Even the guards could learn this one, and that's saying something.
zh: 连守卫都能学会这个，这可就很能说明问题了。

keys: Even worse, it seems cacti are also affected.
en: Even worse, it seems cacti are also affected.
zh: 更糟的是，仙人掌好像也受到了影响。

keys: Eventually I made enough to buy my own ship. It was almost a wreck, but I worked on it day and night until it was ready to sail again.
en: Eventually I made enough to buy my own ship. It was almost a wreck, but I worked on it day and night until it was ready to sail again.
zh: 后来我攒够了钱，买下了自己的船。那几乎是一堆残骸，但我日夜修整，直到它能重新出海。

keys: Ever since then they've been updating the people of Tulimshar about the flow of energies.
en: Ever since then they've been updating the people of Tulimshar about the flow of energies.
zh: 从那以后，他们就一直向图利姆沙的居民通报魔力的动向。

keys: Except for you... but I guess Frost sent you, so it's different.
en: Except for you... but I guess Frost sent you, so it's different.
zh: 除了你……不过我想是弗罗斯特派你来的，那就不一样了。

keys: Except it wasn't, obviously. Because here I am, guarding walls nobody's trying to break through.
en: Except it wasn't, obviously. Because here I am, guarding walls nobody's trying to break through.
zh: 只是显然并没有。因为现在我还在守着根本没人想突破的城墙。

keys: Excuse me?! Did you say a Mana Tree? Alive? In the Sandstorm Mines???
en: Excuse me?! Did you say a Mana Tree? Alive? In the Sandstorm Mines???
zh: 等等？！你是说魔力树？还活着？就在沙暴矿洞里？？？

keys: Experience wins again. Don't feel bad, most people lose to me.
en: Experience wins again. Don't feel bad, most people lose to me.
zh: 经验又赢了。别难过，大多数人都输给我。

keys: Far end of the western wall corridor to our left, on top of the library shelf.
en: Far end of the western wall corridor to our left, on top of the library shelf.
zh: 在我们左边西墙走廊的尽头，图书馆书架的顶上。

keys: Fill my jug if you find it and bring it back here.
en: Fill my jug if you find it and bring it back here.
zh: 你要是找到我的水壶，就把它灌满带回来给我。

keys: Finally, sulphur clears the bubbles and takes the green out.
en: Finally, sulphur clears the bubbles and takes the green out.
zh: 最后，硫磺能除掉气泡，去掉绿色。

keys: Find them and show them the Kano. Explain what you saw.
en: Find them and show them the Kano. Explain what you saw.
zh: 找到他们，把卡诺给他们看，说明你看到的一切。

keys: Fire-breathing? I have never seen that before.
en: Fire-breathing? I have never seen that before.
zh: 会喷火？我从没见过这种事。

keys: Flooded?
en: Flooded?
zh: 被淹了？

keys: For any other destination we'd need to prepare for a little longer.
en: For any other destination we'd need to prepare for a little longer.
zh: 去别的地方的话，我们得多准备一阵子。

keys: For generations my tribe has been crafting special clothes out of different materials.
en: For generations my tribe has been crafting special clothes out of different materials.
zh: 世世代代，我的部族都在用各种材料制作特殊的衣服。

keys: For that I would need a regular Jeans Shorts and about 10 Snake Skins as those tends to tear when we manipulate them.
en: For that I would need a regular Jeans Shorts and about 10 Snake Skins as those tends to tear when we manipulate them.
zh: 那我就需要一条普通的牛仔裤短裤，再加大约10张蛇皮，因为加工的时候容易扯破。

keys: For the first time in thousands of years, I will be needing someone's help.
en: For the first time in thousands of years, I will be needing someone's help.
zh: 几千年来第一次，我需要有人帮忙了。

keys: Frost handled the people. I handled the stone. That was the deal.
en: Frost handled the people. I handled the stone. That was the deal.
zh: 弗罗斯特管人，我管石头。当初是说好的。

keys: Frost started making rules. Procedures for everything. I told him we didn't need more pressure on top of what we already dealt with.
en: Frost started making rules. Procedures for everything. I told him we didn't need more pressure on top of what we already dealt with.
zh: 弗罗斯特开始立规矩。什么事都要走流程。我告诉他，我们本就压力够大了，不需要再加。

keys: G...goblins? Are... are you sure?
en: G...goblins? Are... are you sure?
zh: 哥……哥布林？你……你确定吗？

keys: Get as close to 21 as you can without going over.
en: Get as close to 21 as you can without going over.
zh: 尽量凑到21点，但别超过。

keys: Get the balance wrong and your glass will be weak. Or worse, ugly.
en: Get the balance wrong and your glass will be weak. Or worse, ugly.
zh: 配比不对，你的玻璃就会脆弱。更糟的是，还会很丑。

keys: Get yourself something light before the sun cooks you alive!
en: Get yourself something light before the sun cooks you alive!
zh: 赶紧弄点轻便的东西戴上，不然太阳会把你烤熟！

keys: Getting rid of 5 peyotes and 5 maggots should suffice to keep our crops safe for the day.
en: Getting rid of 5 peyotes and 5 maggots should suffice to keep our crops safe for the day.
zh: 除掉5株佩奥特和5条蛆虫，今天的庄稼就安全了。

keys: Glad to see you! As you can see, I'm still surrounded by these squirky white maggots.
en: Glad to see you! As you can see, I'm still surrounded by these squirky white maggots.
zh: 很高兴见到你！如你所见，我还是被这些滑溜溜的白色蛆虫围着。

keys: Go forward. I will keep you safe.
en: Go forward. I will keep you safe.
zh: 往前走。我会保护你的。

keys: Go! Don't wait for me to kiss you goodbye.
en: Go! Don't wait for me to kiss you goodbye.
zh: 快走！别等我跟你吻别了。

keys: Gold. He put gold in here. With my name on it.
en: Gold. He put gold in here. With my name on it.
zh: 金子。他在里面放了金子。刻着我的名字。

keys: Good luck out there, I'd still recommend for you to not go there all alone.
en: Good luck out there, I'd still recommend for you to not go there all alone.
zh: 祝你好运，不过我还是建议你别一个人去那儿。

keys: Good luck.
en: Good luck.
zh: 祝你好运。

keys: Good work on the peyotes. Still need you to deal with %d more maggots though.
en: Good work on the peyotes. Still need you to deal with %d more maggots though.
zh: 佩奥特干得不错。不过还得你再解决%d条蛆虫。

keys: Good, she knew it was the right choice.
en: Good, she knew it was the right choice.
zh: 很好，她知道那是正确的选择。

keys: Good. I wasn't going to give you a choice anyway.
en: Good. I wasn't going to give you a choice anyway.
zh: 好。反正本来也没打算给你选择。

keys: Good. You are connected now.
en: Good. You are connected now.
zh: 好。你已经连接上了。

keys: Good. You have everything.
en: Good. You have everything.
zh: 好。你东西都齐了。

keys: Ha! We've got a match! Let's see what you're both made of.
en: Ha! We've got a match! Let's see what you're both made of.
zh: 哈！配上了！让我看看你们俩都是什么成色。

keys: Halt! You must not proceed further.
en: Halt! You must not proceed further.
zh: 站住！不得再往前走。

keys: Hang on, someone's already playing! Wait your turn.
en: Hang on, someone's already playing! Wait your turn.
zh: 等等，已经有人在玩了！排队等着。

keys: Hard to miss, useful landmark.
en: Hard to miss, useful landmark.
zh: 很显眼，是个有用的地标。

keys: Have you found the Manayir yet?
en: Have you found the Manayir yet?
zh: 你找到玛纳伊尔了吗？

keys: Have you seen my chalk?
en: Have you seen my chalk?
zh: 见到我的粉笔了吗？

keys: Have you seen the maggots we have to deal with?
en: Have you seen the maggots we have to deal with?
zh: 你见过我们得对付的那些蛆虫了吗？

keys: He has good instincts, or maybe you made noise while focusing on not being seen. Anyway, he'll be in there.
en: He has good instincts, or maybe you made noise while focusing on not being seen. Anyway, he'll be in there.
zh: 他直觉很准，也可能是你躲避的时候弄出了动静。总之，他就在里面。

keys: He is standing northeast from here near some palm trees.
en: He is standing northeast from here near some palm trees.
zh: 他就在这里东北方向，几棵棕榈树附近。

keys: He kept those letters. That's something, right?
en: He kept those letters. That's something, right?
zh: 他还留着那些信。这说明点什么，对吧？

keys: He knew the risks. Everyone who does this job knows that.
en: He knew the risks. Everyone who does this job knows that.
zh: 他知道风险。干这行的每个人都知道。

keys: He said I was shutting him out, making decisions without telling anyone.
en: He said I was shutting him out, making decisions without telling anyone.
zh: 他说我把他隔绝在外，做事不告诉任何人。

keys: He seemed to be inspecting the walls of the cave. I tried talking to him, but he immediately attacked me without saying anything.
en: He seemed to be inspecting the walls of the cave. I tried talking to him, but he immediately attacked me without saying anything.
zh: 他当时好像在检查洞壁。我想跟他说话，可他二话不说就朝我扑过来。

keys: He seemed to really not care what would happen to me down here when he sent me out alone.
en: He seemed to really not care what would happen to me down here when he sent me out alone.
zh: 他派我独自下来的时候，好像根本不在乎我会在这里遭遇什么。

keys: He sent YOU? I told that sand brained idiot to send NEW RECRUITS.
en: He sent YOU? I told that sand brained idiot to send NEW RECRUITS.
zh: 他派的是你？我叫那个脑袋进沙子的蠢货派新兵来！

keys: He told me to leave. And I just did. I'm not proud of how I handled it, but I got out of the way.
en: He told me to leave. And I just did. I'm not proud of how I handled it, but I got out of the way.
zh: 他让我离开。我就走了。我不为自己当时的处理方式感到骄傲，但我让开了路。

keys: He used to be one of the Manayir. His intentions are different now.
en: He used to be one of the Manayir. His intentions are different now.
zh: 他曾经是玛纳伊尔的一员。现在他的想法不一样了。

keys: He walked away following this corridor. The last time I heard him was below this ledge.
en: He walked away following this corridor. The last time I heard him was below this ledge.
zh: 他沿着这条走廊走了。我最后一次听到他的声音，就是在这块岩壁下面。

keys: He'd better not waste my time up here and get back quickly, or I may just leave him.
en: He'd better not waste my time up here and get back quickly, or I may just leave him.
zh: 他最好别在上面浪费我的时间，赶紧回来，不然我可能就丢下他走了。

keys: He'll know what to do next.
en: He'll know what to do next.
zh: 他知道接下来该怎么做。

keys: Head north. You'll get there.
en: Head north. You'll get there.
zh: 一直往北走。你能到的。

keys: Head south-east of here. The entrance to the mine will be next to an old well.
en: Head south-east of here. The entrance to the mine will be next to an old well.
zh: 从这里往东南走。矿洞入口就在一口旧井旁边。

keys: Heading into the sandstorm without proper headgear? You'll turn into a sand golem in no time!
en: Heading into the sandstorm without proper headgear? You'll turn into a sand golem in no time!
zh: 不戴合适的帽子就闯进沙暴里？你转眼就会变成一座沙傀儡！

keys: Healing Potions require knowledge to make and also some key ingredients. Maybe you could get back on your feet by helping me gather some of these ingredients?
en: Healing Potions require knowledge to make and also some key ingredients. Maybe you could get back on your feet by helping me gather some of these ingredients?
zh: 制作治疗药水需要相关知识，还需要一些关键材料。或许你可以帮我收集一些材料，顺便重新站稳脚跟？

keys: Heh... Not bad.
en: Heh... Not bad.
zh: 呵……不错嘛。

keys: Hello again.
en: Hello again.
zh: 又见面了。

keys: Hello, are you the one they pulled off the sand? Glad to see you walking about. I need your help.
en: Hello, are you the one they pulled off the sand? Glad to see you walking about. I need your help.
zh: 你好，你是他们从沙子里刨出来的那个人吗？很高兴看到你还能走动。我需要你帮忙。

keys: Hello, welcome to Tulimshar!
en: Hello, welcome to Tulimshar!
zh: 你好，欢迎来到图利姆沙！

keys: Hello. Elanore sent you? Welcome.
en: Hello. Elanore sent you? Welcome.
zh: 你好。是埃兰诺让你来的？欢迎。

keys: Help.
en: Help.
zh: 救命。

keys: Helping the people out here is much better than being stuck in some tower or palace. More of the leaders of this city should think about that.
en: Helping the people out here is much better than being stuck in some tower or palace. More of the leaders of this city should think about that.
zh: 在外面帮助这些人，比困在什么高塔或宫殿里强多了。这座城的更多领导者真该想想这一点。

keys: Here is an important tip for you: to find it, I remember I first went north then east...
en: Here is an important tip for you: to find it, I remember I first went north then east...
zh: 给你个提示：想找到它的话，我记得我先往北再往东……

keys: Here is the jug. The water source is deep inside the cave.
en: Here is the jug. The water source is deep inside the cave.
zh: 水罐在这儿。水源在洞穴深处。

keys: Here you are!
en: Here you are!
zh: 给，拿着！

keys: Here, take this sword. Better than walking out there empty-handed.
en: Here, take this sword. Better than walking out there empty-handed.
zh: 来，拿着这把剑。总比你空着手出去强。

keys: Here, take this sword. It's not much, but it will cut through Maggots and Peyotes just fine.
en: Here, take this sword. It's not much, but it will cut through Maggots and Peyotes just fine.
zh: 来，拿这把剑。不算好东西，但砍蛆虫和佩奥特仙人掌足够了。

keys: Here, take this. It's all I have left.
en: Here, take this. It's all I have left.
zh: 拿着这个。这是我仅剩的全部了。

keys: Here. You take it. You've done more for us in one afternoon than we managed in years.
en: Here. You take it. You've done more for us in one afternoon than we managed in years.
zh: 拿着吧，给你了。你一个下午为我们做的，比我们多年做的还多。

keys: Hey! Are you new to the city? I don't think I've seen you before. My name is Eridu. I'm a glassmaker.
en: Hey! Are you new to the city? I don't think I've seen you before. My name is Eridu. I'm a glassmaker.
zh: 嘿！你是刚来城里的吗？我没见过你。我叫埃里杜，是个玻璃匠。

keys: Hey, no cheating! Go play your game!
en: Hey, no cheating! Go play your game!
zh: 嘿，别耍赖！去玩你自己的游戏！

keys: Hey, someone's already waiting to play! You should go against them!
en: Hey, someone's already waiting to play! You should go against them!
zh: 嘿，已经有人在等着玩了！你应该去跟他们对战！

keys: Hi! I'm Watchman Nathan.
en: Hi! I'm Watchman Nathan.
zh: 你好！我是守卫内森。

keys: His name is Nickos. He hasn't been back for a while.
en: His name is Nickos. He hasn't been back for a while.
zh: 他叫尼科斯。他有一阵子没回来了。

keys: His pay was his own to collect. Consider it yours for the report.
en: His pay was his own to collect. Consider it yours for the report.
zh: 他的工钱本来就该他自己来领。就当你汇报的报酬吧。

keys: Hmm, you don't seem to have the ingredients anymore.
en: Hmm, you don't seem to have the ingredients anymore.
zh: 嗯，你的材料好像已经没了。

keys: Hold Run to sprint and cover ground faster or flee a battle.
en: Hold Run to sprint and cover ground faster or flee a battle.
zh: 按住奔跑键冲刺，能更快赶路或逃离战斗。

keys: Hold it right there.
en: Hold it right there.
zh: 站住，别动。

keys: Hot sand burns through bare feet in no time. Need some boots?
en: Hot sand burns through bare feet in no time. Need some boots?
zh: 灼热的沙子很快就能烫穿光脚。要来双靴子吗？

keys: How did you come to find this?
en: How did you come to find this?
zh: 你是怎么发现这个的？

keys: How does it know me? This is all... very hard to grasp.
en: How does it know me? This is all... very hard to grasp.
zh: 它怎么会认识我？这一切……太难理解了。

keys: How does that sound?
en: How does that sound?
zh: 听起来怎么样？

keys: How was the expedition?
en: How was the expedition?
zh: 探险怎么样？

keys: I already dealt with one of you earlier, but you followed me too far, I won't be as forgiving with you.
en: I already dealt with one of you earlier, but you followed me too far, I won't be as forgiving with you.
zh: 我之前已经打发过一个你们这种人了，但你们追得太远，我不会再手下留情。

keys: I am a bit hungry though. Not that I would ask you to bring me food! I'll take care of it later.
en: I am a bit hungry though. Not that I would ask you to bring me food! I'll take care of it later.
zh: 不过我确实有点饿。当然不是让你给我带吃的！我回头自己解决。

keys: I bet the guards took it to play with on their own.
en: I bet the guards took it to play with on their own.
zh: 我猜是卫兵们拿去自己玩了。

keys: I came here for the Kano. I did not expect to find a living Uru hiding in the dark. How does it survive?
en: I came here for the Kano. I did not expect to find a living Uru hiding in the dark. How does it survive?
zh: 我是来寻找卡诺的。没想到会在这里发现一头活着的魔力树躲在黑暗中。它是怎么活下来的？

keys: I can stay in the shade all day and rest while other guards keep the wildlife outside our walls.
en: I can stay in the shade all day and rest while other guards keep the wildlife outside our walls.
zh: 我可以整天待在阴凉里休息，其他守卫会把野兽挡在城墙外。

keys: I can't draw round circles, so I just draw squares instead. But Andi keeps making fun of me.
en: I can't draw round circles, so I just draw squares instead. But Andi keeps making fun of me.
zh: 我画不好圆形，所以就用方块代替。可安迪老是笑话我。

keys: I come out here to trade. That is as far as most strangers get.
en: I come out here to trade. That is as far as most strangers get.
zh: 我是出来做买卖的。大多数陌生人也就只能走到这一步。

keys: I could have defended myself just as I defended you, but he would have left, as he just did.
en: I could have defended myself just as I defended you, but he would have left, as he just did.
zh: 我本可以像保护你那样保护自己，但他会离开的，就像刚才那样。

keys: I didn't expect to find anyone down here, but there was a strange man wearing a dark robe.
en: I didn't expect to find anyone down here, but there was a strange man wearing a dark robe.
zh: 没想到下面还有人，不过有个穿黑袍的怪人。

keys: I do miss it, but we get to go back often, even if it's not for long. Lots of goods come in and out of Artis.
en: I do miss it, but we get to go back often, even if it's not for long. Lots of goods come in and out of Artis.
zh: 我确实想念那里，但我们经常回去，即使待不长。阿蒂斯有大量货物进出。

keys: I don't care why you're here. Turn around.
en: I don't care why you're here. Turn around.
zh: 我不管你为什么来。转身走。

keys: I don't deserve this. It should belong to someone who is a better friend than I managed to be.
en: I don't deserve this. It should belong to someone who is a better friend than I managed to be.
zh: 这东西我不配拥有。它应该属于一个比我做得更好的朋友。

keys: I don't feel the same dark presence that I felt with the first one who came through here. Please come forward.
en: I don't feel the same dark presence that I felt with the first one who came through here. Please come forward.
zh: 我感觉不到之前经过这里的第一个人身上的那种黑暗气息。请过来吧。

keys: I don't have all my tools here, let me think... Does a pair of jean chaps interest you?
en: I don't have all my tools here, let me think... Does a pair of jean chaps interest you?
zh: 我的工具不全在这儿，让我想想……一条牛仔护腿裤套你感兴趣吗？

keys: I don't have time to satisfy your curiosity and I cannot let you leave this place.
en: I don't have time to satisfy your curiosity and I cannot let you leave this place.
zh: 我没时间满足你的好奇心，也不能放你离开这个地方。

keys: I don't know if it'll change anything. But maybe if he read them again he'd remember we weren't always like this.
en: I don't know if it'll change anything. But maybe if he read them again he'd remember we weren't always like this.
zh: 我不知道这会不会有什么改变。但也许他再读一遍，就会记起我们并非一直如此。

keys: I even taught some students at one point.
en: I even taught some students at one point.
zh: 我还教过一些学生呢。

keys: I got some friends together: Gado, Julia and my old pal Magic Arpan. We had all worked together before at the port.
en: I got some friends together: Gado, Julia and my old pal Magic Arpan. We had all worked together before at the port.
zh: 我叫上了一些朋友：加多、朱莉娅，还有我的老伙计魔法师阿尔潘。我们以前在港口一起干过。

keys: I guess this is why they put me out here... I must be so annoying.
en: I guess this is why they put me out here... I must be so annoying.
zh: 我想这就是他们把我派到这儿的原因……我一定很烦人。

keys: I guess you have many questions before going out, what can I help you with?
en: I guess you have many questions before going out, what can I help you with?
zh: 我想你出门前有很多问题，需要我帮忙吗？

keys: I had known some of them for a long time. Gado was my first mate for a time.  Julia was my cook.
en: I had known some of them for a long time. Gado was my first mate for a time.  Julia was my cook.
zh: 他们中有些人我跟了很久。加多当过一段时间的我的大副。朱莉娅是我的厨子。

keys: I have no choice but to trust that you will take good decisions.
en: I have no choice but to trust that you will take good decisions.
zh: 我别无选择，只能相信你会做出正确的决定。

keys: I have only ever read about these. I never imagined I would see one in my lifetime.
en: I have only ever read about these. I never imagined I would see one in my lifetime.
zh: 我只在书上读到过这种东西。从没想到这辈子能亲眼见到。

keys: I have only read about these, we all have. I never thought we would see one again.
en: I have only read about these, we all have. I never thought we would see one again.
zh: 我只在书上读到过，我们都是。没想到还能再见到。

keys: I have plenty of that, as you can see.
en: I have plenty of that, as you can see.
zh: 这种东西我多的是，你也看到了。

keys: I have sand in my teeth from the storm. I can only imagine what the miners who used to work here went though, walking here every day.
en: I have sand in my teeth from the storm. I can only imagine what the miners who used to work here went though, walking here every day.
zh: 风暴把我牙齿里都是沙子。可想而知从前在这里干活的矿工每天走这条路是什么滋味。

keys: I have sent one of these idiots to scout ahead, but it seems that he got lost.
en: I have sent one of these idiots to scout ahead, but it seems that he got lost.
zh: 我派了其中一个蠢货去前面探路，可他好像迷路了。

keys: I have what I want.
en: I have what I want.
zh: 我想要的东西已经到手了。

keys: I heard some noises coming from further below. I really don't want to go there...
en: I heard some noises coming from further below. I really don't want to go there...
zh: 我听到下面深处传来一些响声。我真不想去那里……

keys: I heard there's a city to the north with cold, white sand.
en: I heard there's a city to the north with cold, white sand.
zh: 听说北边有座城市，沙子又冷又白。

keys: I just hope I can go back to guarding the port. If they station me here permanently I might just go feed myself to a goblin.
en: I just hope I can go back to guarding the port. If they station me here permanently I might just go feed myself to a goblin.
zh: 我只希望能回去守港口。要是他们把我永久派驻在这儿，我干脆去喂哥布林算了。

keys: I just want to pour it on my face so I feel less cooked by this heat.
en: I just want to pour it on my face so I feel less cooked by this heat.
zh: 我只想把水泼在脸上，好让自己不那么像被烤熟。

keys: I just wanted to build things and have people stop arguing about how I build them.
en: I just wanted to build things and have people stop arguing about how I build them.
zh: 我只想造东西，让人们别再为我的造法吵个没完。

keys: I just wish that more people embraced the ancient traditions more openly. The Savean beliefs have brought much trouble to our world. Now they have even spawned these new cultists, the Varunian, who essentially worship Kaore.
en: I just wish that more people embraced the ancient traditions more openly. The Savean beliefs have brought much trouble to our world. Now they have even spawned these new cultists, the Varunian, who essentially worship Kaore.
zh: 我只希望更多人能更坦率地接纳古老传统。萨文信仰给我们世界带来了太多麻烦。现在甚至催生了这些新邪教徒——瓦鲁尼亚人，他们基本上崇拜考尔。

keys: I keep thinking I should walk over there. To the corridor. Not today, but I decided I will.
en: I keep thinking I should walk over there. To the corridor. Not today, but I decided I will.
zh: 我总想着该走过去看看。去那条走廊。不是今天，但我决定了，我会去的。

keys: I knew you'd understand. Hydration is important! I'll be waiting for you, friend.
en: I knew you'd understand. Hydration is important! I'll be waiting for you, friend.
zh: 我就知道你能明白。补水很重要！我会等你的，朋友。

keys: I know this handwriting.
en: I know this handwriting.
zh: 我认得这字迹。

keys: I miss my students though. Maybe one day I'll go back to teaching. Who knows?
en: I miss my students though. Maybe one day I'll go back to teaching. Who knows?
zh: 不过我还是想念我的学生们。也许有一天我会回去教书。谁知道呢？

keys: I need a moment.
en: I need a moment.
zh: 我需要缓一缓。

keys: I need six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya for each potion. Bring those to me and I will make you a Cactus Potion in return.
en: I need six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya for each potion. Bring those to me and I will make you a Cactus Potion in return.
zh: 每瓶药水我需要六份蛆虫黏液、一份水和一份火龙果。把东西带给我，我就给你做仙人掌药水。

keys: I once felt something in that direction, a long time ago. I assumed it was a deep Zielite deposit. I had no idea.
en: I once felt something in that direction, a long time ago. I assumed it was a deep Zielite deposit. I had no idea.
zh: 很久以前，我曾在那个方向感觉到过什么。我以为是深层泽利石矿脉。完全没想到是这样。

keys: I saw a pirate crew playing tic-tac-toe against some guards the other day.
en: I saw a pirate crew playing tic-tac-toe against some guards the other day.
zh: 前几天我看见一伙海盗在和几个守卫玩井字棋。

keys: I started calling her \"the wild X\".
en: I started calling her \"the wild X\".
zh: 我就开始叫她"野X"。

keys: I started making rules. Procedures for everything. I thought if I could just organize it all, maybe the pressure wouldn't crush us.
en: I started making rules. Procedures for everything. I thought if I could just organize it all, maybe the pressure wouldn't crush us.
zh: 我开始定规矩。事事都有流程。我想只要把一切理顺，压力也许就不会压垮我们。

keys: I started out as carpenter in the port of Artis. I didn't have much at the time, but I was good at my job.
en: I started out as carpenter in the port of Artis. I didn't have much at the time, but I was good at my job.
zh: 我最初是阿蒂斯港口的木匠。那时我没什么钱，但活干得好。

keys: I still need six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya for each potion. Come back when you have them.
en: I still need six Maggot Slimes, one Water and one Pitaya for each potion. Come back when you have them.
zh: 我还是需要每瓶药水六份蛆虫黏液、一份水和一份火龙果。凑齐了再来。

keys: I thought I could fight the snakes back, but I did not expect to find this many!
en: I thought I could fight the snakes back, but I did not expect to find this many!
zh: 我本想反击那些蛇，但没想到会有这么多！

keys: I thought he'd spent this after I left. I would have understood if he did.
en: I thought he'd spent this after I left. I would have understood if he did.
zh: 我以为我走后他会把钱花掉。如果他真花了，我也能理解。

keys: I tried to reach the pond but the snakes keep attacking and I spill all the water that I collect.
en: I tried to reach the pond but the snakes keep attacking and I spill all the water that I collect.
zh: 我想去池塘，可蛇一直袭击我，打来的水全洒光了。

keys: I understand. Come back if you change your mind.
en: I understand. Come back if you change your mind.
zh: 我明白了。你改变主意的话就回来。

keys: I was attacked by... Someone?
en: I was attacked by... Someone?
zh: 我被……什么东西袭击了？

keys: I was born here, hidden from the world. Over time the Manayir let their knowledge of my existence fade, even from their own, so that I would remain hidden.
en: I was born here, hidden from the world. Over time the Manayir let their knowledge of my existence fade, even from their own, so that I would remain hidden.
zh: 我出生在这里，与世隔绝。随着时间的推移，玛纳伊尔们甚至让他们自己人也淡忘了我存在的知识，好让我一直隐藏下去。

keys: I was starting to think you'd gotten lost too. What happened down there?
en: I was starting to think you'd gotten lost too. What happened down there?
zh: 我还以为你也迷路了。下面出什么事了？

keys: I will be. I need to catch my breath.
en: I will be. I need to catch my breath.
zh: 我会没事的。我需要喘口气。

keys: I will go back to Tulimshar now, this area is way too dangerous.
en: I will go back to Tulimshar now, this area is way too dangerous.
zh: 我现在就回图利姆沙去，这一带太危险了。

keys: I won't lie to you, he probably thinks you won't make it back...
en: I won't lie to you, he probably thinks you won't make it back...
zh: 我不想骗你，他多半觉得你回不来……

keys: I wonder where the water came from.
en: I wonder where the water came from.
zh: 不知道这些水是从哪儿来的。

keys: I would ask you to never speak to anyone of my existence.
en: I would ask you to never speak to anyone of my existence.
zh: 请你永远不要向任何人提起我的存在。

keys: I would like to give you something in return, but your bag is full. Make some room and come back to me.
en: I would like to give you something in return, but your bag is full. Make some room and come back to me.
zh: 我想送你点东西作为回报，但你的包满了。腾出点空间再来找我。

keys: I wouldn't want to be paying Esperia's harbour fees without good reason! Or Hurnscald for that matter.
en: I wouldn't want to be paying Esperia's harbour fees without good reason! Or Hurnscald for that matter.
zh: 我可不想没理由去付埃斯佩里亚的港口费！赫尔恩斯卡德的也一样。

keys: I'd like to see her half-buried in the sands with scorpions poking at her corpse.
en: I'd like to see her half-buried in the sands with scorpions poking at her corpse.
zh: 我倒想看她半埋在沙子里，任蝎子戳她的尸体。

keys: I'll get to making some new bottles right away.
en: I'll get to making some new bottles right away.
zh: 我这就去制作新瓶子。

keys: I'm %s. I help people find their footing around here.
en: I'm %s. I help people find their footing around here.
zh: 我是%s。我帮人们在这里站稳脚跟。

keys: I'm getting to it!
en: I'm getting to it!
zh: 这就去办！

keys: I'm glad it trusted me, but we will need to let the Manayir know about this. They are an ancient order of druids who were once guardians of these trees.
en: I'm glad it trusted me, but we will need to let the Manayir know about this. They are an ancient order of druids who were once guardians of these trees.
zh: 它肯信任我，我很高兴，但我们得把这事告诉玛纳伊尔。他们是一支古老的德鲁伊教团，曾是这些树的守护者。

keys: I'm glad you found me. I was worried that the man would come back to finish me.
en: I'm glad you found me. I was worried that the man would come back to finish me.
zh: 幸好你找到了我。我担心那个家伙会回来取我的命。

keys: I'm going to be honest with you. It's not even for drinking. I have that with me.
en: I'm going to be honest with you. It's not even for drinking. I have that with me.
zh: 我跟你说实话吧。那水根本不是喝的。我随身带着它。

keys: I'm normally guarding the port of Tulimshar, but today I have the honour of GETTING ABSOLUTELY BAKED TO A CRISP OUT HERE.
en: I'm normally guarding the port of Tulimshar, but today I have the honour of GETTING ABSOLUTELY BAKED TO A CRISP OUT HERE.
zh: 我平时守卫图利姆沙港，但今天我非常荣幸地在这外面被烤得焦脆。

keys: I'm not venturing much further if I can help it. Here, I have a spare helmet.
en: I'm not venturing much further if I can help it. Here, I have a spare helmet.
zh: 能不冒风险我就不往深处走了。给，我有个备用头盔。

keys: I'm sure they'll be happy to chat, especially if you buy some of their wares.
en: I'm sure they'll be happy to chat, especially if you buy some of their wares.
zh: 他们肯定乐意跟你聊聊，尤其你要是买点他们的货。

keys: I'm the captain of La Johanne, the vessel docked right behind me.
en: I'm the captain of La Johanne, the vessel docked right behind me.
zh: 我是"乔安娜号"的船长，就停泊在我身后。

keys: I'm too young to remember, but until a few decades ago life was much more difficult for everyone.
en: I'm too young to remember, but until a few decades ago life was much more difficult for everyone.
zh: 我年纪太小记不清，但在几十年前，每个人的日子都艰难得多。

keys: I'm... I'm not scared! If that's what you were wondering. I AM NOT SCARED OF GOBLINS!
en: I'm... I'm not scared! If that's what you were wondering. I AM NOT SCARED OF GOBLINS!
zh: 我……我才不怕呢！如果你想问的是这个。我才不怕哥布林！

keys: I've made too many mistakes to think I was right about everything. But back then, neither of us would bend.
en: I've made too many mistakes to think I was right about everything. But back then, neither of us would bend.
zh: 我犯过的错太多，不敢说自己事事都对。但那时候，我们谁都不肯让步。

keys: I've seen scorpions down there big enough to swallow a man whole. I guess it wouldn't be so unthinkable for them to breathe fire.
en: I've seen scorpions down there big enough to swallow a man whole. I guess it wouldn't be so unthinkable for them to breathe fire.
zh: 我在下面见过大得能整个吞下一个人的蝎子。它们会喷火也就不算太离谱了。

keys: If I lose anyone else I'll never be allowed to lead anyone outside the city walls again.
en: If I lose anyone else I'll never be allowed to lead anyone outside the city walls again.
zh: 要是再失去任何人，我就再也不能带人出城墙了。

keys: If you ask me, I believe that magic is a natural part of our world. It has led us to where we are today, and despite being the most dangerous force of nature, we need it.
en: If you ask me, I believe that magic is a natural part of our world. It has led us to where we are today, and despite being the most dangerous force of nature, we need it.
zh: 要我说，我相信魔法是我们世界的自然组成部分。它把我们带到了今天，虽然它是最危险的自然之力，我们仍然离不开它。

keys: If you could find someone else to help, I'm sure it would be easier to fight back the snakes and collect more water.
en: If you could find someone else to help, I'm sure it would be easier to fight back the snakes and collect more water.
zh: 你要是能找个帮手，我相信击退蛇和多打些水都会更容易。

keys: If you ever find another Soul Menhir, touch it. You will become attuned to the last on you have touched.
en: If you ever find another Soul Menhir, touch it. You will become attuned to the last on you have touched.
zh: 如果再遇到另一座灵魂石碑，就去触碰它。你会与你最后触碰的那座建立共鸣。

keys: If you find yourself crossing outside of this valley, you'll know it's the wrong direction.
en: If you find yourself crossing outside of this valley, you'll know it's the wrong direction.
zh: 如果你发现自己在跨越这道山谷，那说明方向错了。

keys: If you follow the western pass right there you'll leave Tulimshar Valley and venture into the Zuni Mesas.
en: If you follow the western pass right there you'll leave Tulimshar Valley and venture into the Zuni Mesas.
zh: 沿着那边的西边隘口走，你就会离开图利姆沙谷，进入祖尼台地。

keys: If you follow this road the the east you'll be leaving the Tulimshar Valley and heading towards the Manayir Coast.
en: If you follow this road the the east you'll be leaving the Tulimshar Valley and heading towards the Manayir Coast.
zh: 沿这条路往东走，你就会离开图利姆沙谷，朝玛纳伊尔海岸去。

keys: If you follow this road you will be walking further away from the Sandstorm Mines.
en: If you follow this road you will be walking further away from the Sandstorm Mines.
zh: 沿这条路走下去，你会离沙暴矿洞越来越远。

keys: If you get three in a row you win! Like across, up and down, or the diagonal ones.
en: If you get three in a row you win! Like across, up and down, or the diagonal ones.
zh: 三个连成一线就赢了！横着、竖着或斜着都行。

keys: If you keep going east you will find Manayir Island, just further along the beach.
en: If you keep going east you will find Manayir Island, just further along the beach.
zh: 继续往东走，你会看到玛纳伊尔岛，就在海滩再往前一点。

keys: If you want to be useful and repay the debt you owe us you should help Kael clear out some maggots.
en: If you want to be useful and repay the debt you owe us you should help Kael clear out some maggots.
zh: 想有点用处、偿还你欠我们的债的话，就去帮卡尔清理蛆虫吧。

keys: If you want to know more, you'd better ask my apprentice, Nina. She is currently overseeing the city's Soul Menhir. You can learn a lot more from her.
en: If you want to know more, you'd better ask my apprentice, Nina. She is currently overseeing the city's Soul Menhir. You can learn a lot more from her.
zh: 想知道更多的话，你最好去问我的学徒尼娜。她目前负责管理这座城市的灵魂石碑。你能从她那里学到更多。

keys: If your opponent is no match, run for your life. There is no pride in being dead.
en: If your opponent is no match, run for your life. There is no pride in being dead.
zh: 如果对手不是你的敌手，就逃命吧。死了可没什么荣耀可言。

keys: Impressive work!
en: Impressive work!
zh: 干得漂亮！

keys: In ancient times, there were many, each serving as a stabilizing force, preventing Mana from decaying into Kaore.
en: In ancient times, there were many, each serving as a stabilizing force, preventing Mana from decaying into Kaore.
zh: 在古代，这样的树有很多，每一棵都是一股稳定之力，防止魔力衰变为考尔。

keys: In fact, she claims to be Queen of Tonori. As if she could control anything beyond the city walls.
en: In fact, she claims to be Queen of Tonori. As if she could control anything beyond the city walls.
zh: 其实，她自称托诺里女王。仿佛她能控制城墙外的任何东西似的。

keys: Inside, sacks of fine milled flour, just as Riskim described.
en: Inside, sacks of fine milled flour, just as Riskim described.
zh: 里面是一袋袋精磨面粉，和里斯金姆说的一样。

keys: Instead of nourishing life, it festers, corrupts, and decays. It seeps into the land, warping living beings into hostile, aggressive forms.
en: Instead of nourishing life, it festers, corrupts, and decays. It seeps into the land, warping living beings into hostile, aggressive forms.
zh: 它不是滋养生命，而是溃烂、腐化、衰败。它渗入大地，把生灵扭曲成充满敌意的形态。

keys: Is it the last one or are there more?
en: Is it the last one or are there more?
zh: 这是最后一个，还是还有更多？

keys: Is that a silly request?
en: Is that a silly request?
zh: 这要求是不是很傻？

keys: Is there something else on your mind?
en: Is there something else on your mind?
zh: 还有别的事在想吗？

keys: It depends on who you ask. Some people, like the Red Queen, would say that life is better without magic.
en: It depends on who you ask. Some people, like the Red Queen, would say that life is better without magic.
zh: 这要看你问谁。有些人，比如红发女王，会说没有魔法生活会更好。

keys: It flows through the world's biomass, forming an interconnected web of energy. Properly channelled, it can be harnessed to produce magic, heal the land, and sustain life.
en: It flows through the world's biomass, forming an interconnected web of energy. Properly channelled, it can be harnessed to produce magic, heal the land, and sustain life.
zh: 它流经世界的生物圈，构成一张彼此相连的能量之网。经过正确引导，它能被用来施展魔法、治愈大地、维持生命。

keys: It goes down deep. I wonder how far they want us to go; and I wonder if anything lives down there now.
en: It goes down deep. I wonder how far they want us to go; and I wonder if anything lives down there now.
zh: 它一直通向深处。不知道他们想让我们挖多深；也不知道下面现在是否还住着什么东西。

keys: It has an eerie feel to it. Maybe it's just because it was abandoned for so long?
en: It has an eerie feel to it. Maybe it's just because it was abandoned for so long?
zh: 这地方有种阴森的感觉。也许只是因为它被废弃太久了？

keys: It is a Zielite Amulet. The stone at its centre is a fragment of pure Zielite, the same mineral this Menhir is made of.
en: It is a Zielite Amulet. The stone at its centre is a fragment of pure Zielite, the same mineral this Menhir is made of.
zh: 这是一枚泽利石护符。正中的石头是一块纯泽利石，和这座石碑是同一种矿物。

keys: It is an exceptionally rare thing, as it can sprout into a new Uru. It is particularly precious at this time in our history, as I am the last Uru that is left alive.
en: It is an exceptionally rare thing, as it can sprout into a new Uru. It is particularly precious at this time in our history, as I am the last Uru that is left alive.
zh: 它极其稀有，因为它能长成一个新的魔力树。在我们这个时代它尤为珍贵，因为我是最后一只活着的魔力树了。

keys: It is how we Kahwe have always protected those under our care. I should have given you one sooner.
en: It is how we Kahwe have always protected those under our care. I should have given you one sooner.
zh: 我们卡韦一族向来如此守护受我们照看的人。我早该给你一个了。

keys: It is indeed! I can see why this place was abandoned.
en: It is indeed! I can see why this place was abandoned.
zh: 没错！我明白这地方为什么被废弃了。

keys: It looks like you can squeeze through.
en: It looks like you can squeeze through.
zh: 看起来你能挤过去。

keys: It seems that our hopeless royalty is running low on funds now. She has ordered the mines to be reopened at all costs.
en: It seems that our hopeless royalty is running low on funds now. She has ordered the mines to be reopened at all costs.
zh: 看来我们那位没救的王室现在手头紧了。她下令不惜一切代价重新开放矿洞。

keys: It sounded like he was walking in water. Then I heard crumbling rocks.
en: It sounded like he was walking in water. Then I heard crumbling rocks.
zh: 听起来他像是在水里走。然后我听到岩石崩塌的声音。

keys: It takes %d Salt, %d Bone and %d Sulphur Powder for one bottle. Twice that and you get two. It's simple, really.
en: It takes %d Salt, %d Bone and %d Sulphur Powder for one bottle. Twice that and you get two. It's simple, really.
zh: 一瓶要%d份盐、%d份骨头和%d份硫磺粉。两倍的量就是两瓶。其实很简单。

keys: It worked, for a while.
en: It worked, for a while.
zh: 起了一阵作用，但也只是暂时。

keys: It's a quiet area of Tonori close to the sea. It probably has the mildest climate out of any area in this desert.
en: It's a quiet area of Tonori close to the sea. It probably has the mildest climate out of any area in this desert.
zh: 那是托诺里靠近海边的一片安静地方。它的气候可能是这片沙漠里最温和的。

keys: It's been a while since I've ferried someone out to sea. We usually handle cargo, not people.
en: It's been a while since I've ferried someone out to sea. We usually handle cargo, not people.
zh: 我有一阵子没载客出海了。我们通常运货，不载人。

keys: It's dangerous. Lots of snakes, and that's the friendly part. Some native people live out there too, I don't want to deal with them, I heard they eat raw birds and dance with their feathers.
en: It's dangerous. Lots of snakes, and that's the friendly part. Some native people live out there too, I don't want to deal with them, I heard they eat raw birds and dance with their feathers.
zh: 那里很危险。到处是蛇，这还算好的。那里也住着一些本地人，我可不想跟他们打交道，听说他们生吃禽鸟，还拿着羽毛跳舞。

keys: It's much like weather, different concentrations of Mana and Kaore are everchanging and can affect all living things in the area.
en: It's much like weather, different concentrations of Mana and Kaore are everchanging and can affect all living things in the area.
zh: 它就像天气一样，魔力与考尔的浓度时刻变化，会影响该地区的一切生灵。

keys: It's this evil force that twists living things into... I don't know... Worse versions of themselves? I suppose. More aggressive.
en: It's this evil force that twists living things into... I don't know... Worse versions of themselves? I suppose. More aggressive.
zh: 就是那股邪恶力量，它把生灵扭曲成……怎么说呢……更糟糕的版本？我想是吧。更具攻击性。

keys: It's usually busy, I wouldn't mess with sailors while they work if I were you.
en: It's usually busy, I wouldn't mess with sailors while they work if I were you.
zh: 那里通常很忙，我要是你的话，就不会去惹正在干活的水手。

keys: It's way too dangerous down here. It's not worth the risk just to look for forgotten ores.
en: It's way too dangerous down here. It's not worth the risk just to look for forgotten ores.
zh: 下面实在太危险了。就为找几块被遗忘的矿石不值得冒这个险。

keys: Just follow this wall to the corner and walk up.
en: Just follow this wall to the corner and walk up.
zh: 沿着这面墙走到角落，往上走就行。

keys: Just head south past the city walls and then west.
en: Just head south past the city walls and then west.
zh: 出城墙后一直向南，然后向西。

keys: Kaore had become more plentiful than Mana and for a few hundred years people struggled a lot more than today with mutated and even undead creatures.
en: Kaore had become more plentiful than Mana and for a few hundred years people struggled a lot more than today with mutated and even undead creatures.
zh: 考尔一度比魔力更多样，几百年里，人们要面对变异甚至不死的生物，日子比今天苦得多。

keys: Kaore in many ways is a form of Mana, which is the main energy we can perceive.
en: Kaore in many ways is a form of Mana, which is the main energy we can perceive.
zh: 考尔在许多方面是魔力的一种形态，而魔力是我们能感知的主要能量。

keys: Kaore is affecting all sorts of creatures.
en: Kaore is affecting all sorts of creatures.
zh: 考尔正在影响各种各样的生物。

keys: Kaore is what remains when Mana is severed from its source.
en: Kaore is what remains when Mana is severed from its source.
zh: 考尔就是魔力脱离本源之后剩下的东西。

keys: Keep a look at your vital resources, running into the wild with low health, mana or stamina may not be the wisest choice.
en: Keep a look at your vital resources, running into the wild with low health, mana or stamina may not be the wisest choice.
zh: 注意你的生命状态：在低血量、低魔力或低体力时冲进荒野可不是明智之举。

keys: Keep your favorite objects, potions or even skills nearby, they may be useful during the sandstorm.
en: Keep your favorite objects, potions or even skills nearby, they may be useful during the sandstorm.
zh: 把你喜欢的物品、药水甚至技能放在手边，沙暴来临时也许用得上。

keys: Let me weigh what you have brought...
en: Let me weigh what you have brought...
zh: 让我称一称你带来的东西……

keys: Long ago we were spread across the region, each of us tending to Hantus that grew nearby. That time is behind us now.
en: Long ago we were spread across the region, each of us tending to Hantus that grew nearby. That time is behind us now.
zh: 很久以前，我们一族遍布这片区域，各自照料附近生长的汉图树。那个时代已经过去了。

keys: Long stretch of beach to the east. If you like sand, you'll love it. Not everyone likes sand though...
en: Long stretch of beach to the east. If you like sand, you'll love it. Not everyone likes sand though...
zh: 东边有一大片沙滩。要是你喜欢沙子，你一定会爱死那里。不过不是人人都喜欢沙子……

keys: Look for Watchman Nathan, he should be the one stationed at the mine's entrance.
en: Look for Watchman Nathan, he should be the one stationed at the mine's entrance.
zh: 去找守卫内森吧，他应该驻守在矿洞入口。

keys: Look for him.
en: Look for him.
zh: 去找他吧。

keys: Looked like Tulimshar folks. I wonder what they're up to...
en: Looked like Tulimshar folks. I wonder what they're up to...
zh: 看起来是图利姆沙人。不知道他们在搞什么……

keys: Magic Arpan... how could I not have him on board? We've been good friends for years. He's a charming guy. Literally, he can charm you with magic!
en: Magic Arpan... how could I not have him on board? We've been good friends for years. He's a charming guy. Literally, he can charm you with magic!
zh: 魔法师阿尔潘……我怎么能不带他呢？我们是多年的好友。他是个有魅力的人。真的是字面意义上的——他能用魔法魅惑你！

keys: Mana can behave in unexpected ways.
en: Mana can behave in unexpected ways.
zh: 魔力的行为方式往往出人意料。

keys: Mana flows through all living things, but also infuses a particular mineral known as Zielite. That's what this Soul Menhir is made of.
en: Mana flows through all living things, but also infuses a particular mineral known as Zielite. That's what this Soul Menhir is made of.
zh: 魔力流经一切生灵，也灌注于一种名为泽利石的矿物之中。这座灵魂石碑就是用它造的。

keys: Mana is the life energy that connects us all. Kaore is a decayed form of Mana that corrupts life rather than invigorating it. There is much more to it, but that's the general idea.
en: Mana is the life energy that connects us all. Kaore is a decayed form of Mana that corrupts life rather than invigorating it. There is much more to it, but that's the general idea.
zh: 魔力是连接我们的生命能量。考尔是魔力衰变后的形态，它腐蚀生命而非滋养生命。其中还有更多门道，但大致就是这个意思。

keys: Mana, often called \"lifepower,\" is the essence of all living things.
en: Mana, often called \"lifepower,\" is the essence of all living things.
zh: 魔力，常被称为"生命力"，是一切生灵的本质。

keys: Many years ago this world was full of Uru like me. Our roots were interconnected and Mana flowed more powerfully than it does now.
en: Many years ago this world was full of Uru like me. Our roots were interconnected and Mana flowed more powerfully than it does now.
zh: 许多年前，这个世界上遍布像我这样的魔力树。我们的根彼此相连，魔力的流动也比如今强得多。

keys: May I see it?
en: May I see it?
zh: 我能看看它吗？

keys: Maybe I was, words aren't my tool. Never were.
en: Maybe I was, words aren't my tool. Never were.
zh: 也许吧，言语从来不是我的工具。从来都不是。

keys: Maybe if you bring me the right ones I could make something for you.
en: Maybe if you bring me the right ones I could make something for you.
zh: 也许你把合适的材料带来，我就能给你做点什么。

keys: Maybe this is one of those haunted caves. I'm starting to think we shouldn't go down at all.
en: Maybe this is one of those haunted caves. I'm starting to think we shouldn't go down at all.
zh: 也许这是那种闹鬼的洞穴。我开始觉得我们根本不该下去。

keys: Maybe we should avoid this place. It doesn't seem like we'll find much of use anyway.
en: Maybe we should avoid this place. It doesn't seem like we'll find much of use anyway.
zh: 也许我们该避开这个地方。反正好像也找不到什么有用的东西。

keys: Me, I was the one who talked to people. Organized shifts, sorted out disagreements, kept things running.
en: Me, I was the one who talked to people. Organized shifts, sorted out disagreements, kept things running.
zh: 我呢，是负责跟人打交道的。安排轮班、调解分歧，让一切正常运转。

keys: Meanwhile, I used up my last resources to make these. Take them.
en: Meanwhile, I used up my last resources to make these. Take them.
zh: 与此同时，我用尽了最后的资源做出这些。拿去吧。

keys: Mmh... He's right.
en: Mmh... He's right.
zh: 嗯……他说得对。

keys: Mmh... I see.
en: Mmh... I see.
zh: 嗯……我明白了。

keys: My family has always made glass. People find it useful to carry liquids out in this climate. That's why we mainly make bottles.
en: My family has always made glass. People find it useful to carry liquids out in this climate. That's why we mainly make bottles.
zh: 我家世代做玻璃。在这种气候下，人们需要容器携带液体。所以我们主要做瓶子。

keys: My grandad used to work in this mine. When I was younger he would tell me about it.
en: My grandad used to work in this mine. When I was younger he would tell me about it.
zh: 我爷爷以前在这矿上干活。我小时候他常跟我讲这里的事。

keys: My hand: %s
en: My hand: %s
zh: 我的手：%s

keys: My kind was the first life on our world of Aemil and, until today, I thought I would be the last.
en: My kind was the first life on our world of Aemil and, until today, I thought I would be the last.
zh: 我们这一族是埃米尔世界最早的生命，而直到今天之前，我都以为我将是最后一个。

keys: My location is known now and I need an ally against this new threat.
en: My location is known now and I need an ally against this new threat.
zh: 我的行踪现在已经暴露，我需要一个盟友来对抗这个新的威胁。

keys: My name is Elanore. How are you feeling? You'll need to drink this water and please eat this as well, it will make you feel better.
en: My name is Elanore. How are you feeling? You'll need to drink this water and please eat this as well, it will make you feel better.
zh: 我叫埃兰诺尔。你感觉怎么样？你得把这些水喝了，也请把这个吃下去，会让你好受些。

keys: My name is Elanore. I am the Kahwe of this city and the land that surrounds it. Those outside of our order call us Druids. I represent the Kaumatua, an order devoted to the most ancient tradition in our world.
en: My name is Elanore. I am the Kahwe of this city and the land that surrounds it. Those outside of our order call us Druids. I represent the Kaumatua, an order devoted to the most ancient tradition in our world.
zh: 我叫伊莲诺尔。我是这座城市及周边土地的卡威。我们教团之外的人称我们为德鲁伊。我代表考矛塔瓦，一个致力于世界上最古老传统的教团。

keys: My people were here before them and we are still here today. We trade with Tulimshar when we need to but otherwise we prefer to keep our distances.
en: My people were here before them and we are still here today. We trade with Tulimshar when we need to but otherwise we prefer to keep our distances.
zh: 我的族人比他们更早来到这里，今天也依然在这里。需要时我们会和图利姆沙贸易，但除此之外我们更愿意保持距离。

keys: My roots extend deep into the earth and share in the source of life that empowers all of us: Mana.
en: My roots extend deep into the earth and share in the source of life that empowers all of us: Mana.
zh: 我的根深扎大地，与赋予我们所有人的生命之源相连：魔力。

keys: My water is all gone! I don't know how I will get back to Tulimshar now.
en: My water is all gone! I don't know how I will get back to Tulimshar now.
zh: 我的水全没了！我现在不知道该怎么回图利姆沙了。

keys: Nathan quickly pours all the water you have brought to him all over himself.
en: Nathan quickly pours all the water you have brought to him all over himself.
zh: 内森很快把你带来的所有水全泼在了自己身上。

keys: Nathan thinks to himself
en: Nathan thinks to himself
zh: 内森心中暗想

keys: Need a blade? The guards come to me for theirs.
en: Need a blade? The guards come to me for theirs.
zh: 需要刀剑？守卫们都来我这儿买。

keys: Need anything else?
en: Need anything else?
zh: 还需要别的吗？

keys: Need to know where something is? Ask away.
en: Need to know where something is? Ask away.
zh: 想知道什么东西在哪儿？尽管问。

keys: Never mind. Good luck down there!
en: Never mind. Good luck down there!
zh: 算了。祝你在下面好运！

keys: No surprise, I've seen him get scared by at the sight of a maggot walking towards him.
en: No surprise, I've seen him get scared by at the sight of a maggot walking towards him.
zh: 难怪，我曾见过他被一只朝他爬过来的蛆虫吓到。

keys: Nobody showed up yet... Wanna keep waiting?
en: Nobody showed up yet... Wanna keep waiting?
zh: 还没人来呢……想再等等吗？

keys: None of this is how the relationship with Mana has been for most of Aemil's existence.
en: None of this is how the relationship with Mana has been for most of Aemil's existence.
zh: 在艾米尔的绝大部分历史中，人们与魔力的关系并非如此。

keys: Northeast of here there's a large lighthouse. It overlooks the whole ocean from up there.
en: Northeast of here there's a large lighthouse. It overlooks the whole ocean from up there.
zh: 这儿的东北方有一座大灯塔。从上面可以俯瞰整片海洋。

keys: Not at the moment, but thank you for asking.
en: Not at the moment, but thank you for asking.
zh: 现在没有，不过谢谢你来问。

keys: Not at the moment. I am still hoping for that snack, if you happen to find one!
en: Not at the moment. I am still hoping for that snack, if you happen to find one!
zh: 现在没有。我还盼着那份点心呢，要是你碰巧找到一份！

keys: Not at the moment...
en: Not at the moment...
zh: 现在还没有……

keys: Not done yet. I still need you to clear out %d more peyote from the field.
en: Not done yet. I still need you to clear out %d more peyote from the field.
zh: 还没完成。你还需要再清理田里的 %d 株佩奥特仙人掌。

keys: Not exactly. Kahwes, or Druids, have always been allowed in Tulimshar. If anything because without us the city would not survive the worst droughts and other perils of Tonori's climate.
en: Not exactly. Kahwes, or Druids, have always been allowed in Tulimshar. If anything because without us the city would not survive the worst droughts and other perils of Tonori's climate.
zh: 不完全是。卡威，或者说德鲁伊，一直都允许进入图利姆沙。至少因为要是没有我们，这座城市根本熬不过托诺里气候中最严重的干旱和其他灾难。

keys: Not some random desert wanderer.
en: Not some random desert wanderer.
zh: 可不是什么随便的沙漠流浪者。

keys: Not that I can go anywhere, even if I wanted to...
en: Not that I can go anywhere, even if I wanted to...
zh: 反正就算我想走，也哪儿都去不了……

keys: Now I just need someone to bring me another one...
en: Now I just need someone to bring me another one...
zh: 现在我只需要有人再给我带一个来……

keys: Now he's dead too and his useless daughter is making up stories about her supposed royal bloodline. The truth is that nobody likes her and she needs an excuse so that they let her keep wearing that crown.
en: Now he's dead too and his useless daughter is making up stories about her supposed royal bloodline. The truth is that nobody likes her and she needs an excuse so that they let her keep wearing that crown.
zh: 现在他也死了，他那个没用的女儿正在编造什么王室血统的故事。事实上没人喜欢她，她需要个借口好让别人让她继续戴着那顶王冠。

keys: Now those people inside will have to deal with this.
en: Now those people inside will have to deal with this.
zh: 现在里面的人得自己应付这个了。

keys: Now we make our living going from coast to coast, ferrying goods back and forth. For a fair price too, I'd say.
en: Now we make our living going from coast to coast, ferrying goods back and forth. For a fair price too, I'd say.
zh: 如今我们靠沿海往返运货谋生。价格也算公道，我是这么觉得。

keys: Now we preserve what we still know and continue our studies.
en: Now we preserve what we still know and continue our studies.
zh: 现在我们守护着仍然知晓的一切，继续我们的研究。

keys: Now we wait for someone to show up...
en: Now we wait for someone to show up...
zh: 现在我们等人来就行……

keys: Now, you should make your way to the Manayir. We cannot wait around with a Kano in our hands.
en: Now, you should make your way to the Manayir. We cannot wait around with a Kano in our hands.
zh: 现在，你该去玛纳伊尔了。手里有卡诺，我们不能再耽搁。

keys: Nuh-uh, the board's taken right now!
en: Nuh-uh, the board's taken right now!
zh: 不行不行，棋盘现在有人用！

keys: Number cards are face value, face cards are 10, and Aces... Well, Aces are tricky. They can be 1 or 11. Whatever suits you best.
en: Number cards are face value, face cards are 10, and Aces... Well, Aces are tricky. They can be 1 or 11. Whatever suits you best.
zh: 数字牌按面值算，花牌算 10，至于 A……A 比较微妙，可以算 1 也可以算 11，怎么对你有利怎么来。

keys: Oh dear, it seems you don't have any jeans shorts.
en: Oh dear, it seems you don't have any jeans shorts.
zh: 哎呀，看来你没有牛仔短裤。

keys: Oh dear, it seems you don't have enough snake skins.
en: Oh dear, it seems you don't have enough snake skins.
zh: 哎呀，看来你的蛇皮不够。

keys: Oh my!
en: Oh my!
zh: 天哪！

keys: Oh that's you! Sorry I didn't recognize you with all of this sand.
en: Oh that's you! Sorry I didn't recognize you with all of this sand.
zh: 哦，原来是你！抱歉，满身的沙子让我没认出你来。

keys: Oh, a new face! Welcome to Tulimshar.
en: Oh, a new face! Welcome to Tulimshar.
zh: 哦，新面孔！欢迎来到图利姆沙。

keys: Oh. I thought that he would leave me to die.
en: Oh. I thought that he would leave me to die.
zh: 哦。我还以为他会任我死在那里。

keys: Oh... I understand. No problem. Forget I even asked.
en: Oh... I understand. No problem. Forget I even asked.
zh: 哦……我明白了。没关系，就当我没问过。

keys: Oh... Okay. Here, take one of these. Beyond that, you're going to need to take some time, darling.
en: Oh... Okay. Here, take one of these. Beyond that, you're going to need to take some time, darling.
zh: 哦……好吧。来，拿一个这个。除此之外，亲爱的，你还得花些时间。

keys: Oh... Where did it go? Never mind, maybe another time.
en: Oh... Where did it go? Never mind, maybe another time.
zh: 哦……它去哪儿了？算了，也许下次吧。

keys: Oho, bust! Greed will do that to you. I've seen it a thousand times.
en: Oho, bust! Greed will do that to you. I've seen it a thousand times.
zh: 哦呵，爆掉了！贪婪就会这样，我见过上千次了。

keys: On the inventory window you can handle your items, equipment, potions and any collectibles you found.
en: On the inventory window you can handle your items, equipment, potions and any collectibles you found.
zh: 在物品栏窗口里，你可以管理你的物品、装备、药水以及找到的所有收藏品。

keys: Once they breach the outside they simply burrow into the plant and eat it from the inside. It's a horrible sight.
en: Once they breach the outside they simply burrow into the plant and eat it from the inside. It's a horrible sight.
zh: 它们一旦钻出地面，就会钻进植物里从内部把它吃空。那景象可怕极了。

keys: One bottle. Don't go and break it now!
en: One bottle. Don't go and break it now!
zh: 一瓶。可别给打碎了！

keys: One day, I'm going to the sea to explore the world.
en: One day, I'm going to the sea to explore the world.
zh: 总有一天，我要去看海，去探索世界。

keys: One is sealed with care, the other feels surprisingly heavy.
en: One is sealed with care, the other feels surprisingly heavy.
zh: 一个封得仔细，另一个摸起来出奇地沉。

keys: Opponent's hand: %s%s
en: Opponent's hand: %s%s
zh: 对手的手牌：%s%s

keys: Or maybe it's why it was abandoned in the first place...
en: Or maybe it's why it was abandoned in the first place...
zh: 又或者，这地方本来就是因为这个才被遗弃的……

keys: Our Menhir still stands because it makes people's lives easier. Even those who have opposing beliefs cannot deny the benefit of Mana use. They will oppose it publicly, but when a personal need arises, they will seek Kahwes like myself to heal a loved one or bring some needed rain.
