en: Our Menhir still stands because it makes people's lives easier. Even those who have opposing beliefs cannot deny the benefit of Mana use. They will oppose it publicly, but when a personal need arises, they will seek Kahwes like myself to heal a loved one or bring some needed rain.
zh: 我们的石碑能一直矗立，是因为它让人们的生活更方便。即使是持相反信仰的人也无法否认使用魔力的好处。他们会在公开场合反对它，可一旦有了切身需要，就会来找像我这样的卡威，为所爱之人治疗，或求一场急需的雨。

keys: Our cactus farmers are the most affected by them. The recent increase in the maggots' population has caused a lot of damage to their crops.
en: Our cactus farmers are the most affected by them. The recent increase in the maggots' population has caused a lot of damage to their crops.
zh: 我们的仙人掌农夫受它们影响最深。近来蛆虫数量激增，给庄稼造成了很大损害。

keys: Our old tales talk of how they used to rule Tulimshar in ancient times. Now they mostly keep to themselves.
en: Our old tales talk of how they used to rule Tulimshar in ancient times. Now they mostly keep to themselves.
zh: 我们的古老传说讲过，它们在远古时代曾统治图利姆沙。如今它们大多独来独往。

keys: Our ship is sturdy and fast. We've travelled almost every shore on Aemil. Even as far as Thermin one time!
en: Our ship is sturdy and fast. We've travelled almost every shore on Aemil. Even as far as Thermin one time!
zh: 我们的船结实又快。我们几乎跑遍过艾米尔所有的海岸，最远的一次还去过瑟敏！

keys: Out here it's just me and the dirt. Farming is useful for the city though, so I don't mind it.
en: Out here it's just me and the dirt. Farming is useful for the city though, so I don't mind it.
zh: 在这儿就只有我和泥土。不过种地对城市有用，所以我不介意。

keys: Patience... A good card player learns to wait.
en: Patience... A good card player learns to wait.
zh: 耐心……好的牌手要学会等待。

keys: People used to come here to collect water, but a few years ago the place became infested with snakes.
en: People used to come here to collect water, but a few years ago the place became infested with snakes.
zh: 以前人们常来这里取水，但几年前这地方就被蛇占据了。

keys: Personally, I'd rather stay near the castle than deal with that crowd.
en: Personally, I'd rather stay near the castle than deal with that crowd.
zh: 我个人宁愿待在城堡附近，也不想应付那群人。

keys: Please, take these Cactus Potions and a bit of gold to cover what you spent.
en: Please, take these Cactus Potions and a bit of gold to cover what you spent.
zh: 请收下这些仙人掌药水和一点金币，补上你的花费。

keys: Press Interact near an enemy to automatically target and attack it.
en: Press Interact near an enemy to automatically target and attack it.
zh: 靠近敌人时按下互动键，即可自动锁定并攻击它。

keys: Problem was, Gado likes to argue and he's a great cook. Julia likes her peace... and she's terrible in the kitchen! So, I swapped them around.
en: Problem was, Gado likes to argue and he's a great cook. Julia likes her peace... and she's terrible in the kitchen! So, I swapped them around.
zh: 问题在于，加多爱争辩，又是个好厨子。朱莉娅喜欢清静……厨艺却糟透了！于是我把他们俩调换了一下。

keys: Quiet, though. He'd rather tear down a wall and rebuild it than explain why it needed fixing.
en: Quiet, though. He'd rather tear down a wall and rebuild it than explain why it needed fixing.
zh: 不过他很安静。他宁愿拆掉一堵墙再重建，也不肯解释为什么它需要修。

keys: Quit a few years back. Too much weight on everyone's shoulders up there, you know?
en: Quit a few years back. Too much weight on everyone's shoulders up there, you know?
zh: 好几年前就退了。上面那位置压在每个人肩上的担子太重了，你懂的。

keys: Really? You don't look like a miner. Where is your pickaxe?
en: Really? You don't look like a miner. Where is your pickaxe?
zh: 真的吗？你看起来不像矿工。你的镐呢？

keys: Recently the desert has gotten more dangerous. A group of fanatics obsessed with Kaore has been hiding in the mountains to the east. They have been launching assaults on travellers and once during a major battle they came close to breaching the city wall.
en: Recently the desert has gotten more dangerous. A group of fanatics obsessed with Kaore has been hiding in the mountains to the east. They have been launching assaults on travellers and once during a major battle they came close to breaching the city wall.
zh: 最近沙漠变得越来越危险了。一群痴迷考雷的狂热分子藏匿在东边的山里。他们一直在袭击旅人，有一次大战中他们差点攻破城墙。

keys: Regardless, they need to be culled.
en: Regardless, they need to be culled.
zh: 无论如何，它们必须被清除。

keys: Report back to Watchman Dausen outside of the gates when you're ready to head out.
en: Report back to Watchman Dausen outside of the gates when you're ready to head out.
zh: 准备出发后，去向城门外的守卫道森报到。

keys: Report back to Watchman Ekinu when you're ready.
en: Report back to Watchman Ekinu when you're ready.
zh: 准备好的话，去向守卫埃基努报到。

keys: Right.
en: Right.
zh: 对。

keys: Right...
en: Right...

keys: Right... whatever. Stop talking.
en: Right... whatever. Stop talking.
zh: 对……随便吧。别说了。

keys: Salt, bones, sulphur. You seem to have everything!
en: Salt, bones, sulphur. You seem to have everything!
zh: 盐、骨头、硫磺。你好像都齐了！

keys: Sand is the glass. We melt it and then we cool down the resulting liquid.
en: Sand is the glass. We melt it and then we cool down the resulting liquid.
zh: 沙子就是玻璃的原料。我们把它熔化，然后让得到的液体冷却。

keys: She cares more for that silly garden of hers than she does for the lives of any of us.
en: She cares more for that silly garden of hers than she does for the lives of any of us.
zh: 她在乎她那个愚蠢的花园，胜过在乎我们任何人的性命。

keys: She claims to descend from the Platinum Dynasty, rulers of Tulimshar thousands of years ago. In reality we all know her father was a cactus farmer and she's only Queen because he was a very clever man.
en: She claims to descend from the Platinum Dynasty, rulers of Tulimshar thousands of years ago. In reality we all know her father was a cactus farmer and she's only Queen because he was a very clever man.
zh: 她自称是白金王朝的后裔，图利姆沙数千年前统治者。实际上我们都知道她父亲是个仙人掌农夫，她能当上女王只是因为他父亲是个非常精明的人。

keys: She'd rather not have the same problem here in Tulimshar.
en: She'd rather not have the same problem here in Tulimshar.
zh: 她可不愿图利姆沙也出同样的问题。

keys: She's a cold-hearted, uncaring and selfish person. She spends all her time tending to her garden within the Royal Palace.
en: She's a cold-hearted, uncaring and selfish person. She spends all her time tending to her garden within the Royal Palace.
zh: 她是个冷漠无情、漠不关心又自私自利的人。她把所有时间都花在打理皇家宫殿里她的花园上。

keys: She's the ruler of our city and the whole Kingdom of Tonori, though she doesn't have much power outside of the city walls.
en: She's the ruler of our city and the whole Kingdom of Tonori, though she doesn't have much power outside of the city walls.
zh: 她是我们的城市以及整个托诺里王国的统治者，不过她在城墙之外没什么实权。

keys: Shhh, they're playing! You can watch though.
en: Shhh, they're playing! You can watch though.
zh: 嘘，他们在下呢！不过你可以看。

keys: Sit down, sit down. Show me what you can do. The cards are waiting.
en: Sit down, sit down. Show me what you can do. The cards are waiting.
zh: 坐吧坐吧。让我看看你的本事。牌已经等着了。

keys: Sitting down helps stamina regeneration.
en: Sitting down helps stamina regeneration.
zh: 坐下能帮助恢复体力。

keys: Slimes often have high concentration of salts. Sometimes salt crystals form inside them. It's not easier than letting sea water dry, but it can be faster.
en: Slimes often have high concentration of salts. Sometimes salt crystals form inside them. It's not easier than letting sea water dry, but it can be faster.
zh: 史莱姆体内往往含有高浓度的盐。有时盐晶会在它们体内形成。这不像晒干海水那么省事，但可能更快。

keys: So you pick a square and put your mark on it, then the other person goes.
en: So you pick a square and put your mark on it, then the other person goes.
zh: 就是你选一个格子，落下你的标记，然后轮到对方。

keys: Some of them are jumping around and doing silly faces while splashing nearby crops! You need to help me deal with this.
en: Some of them are jumping around and doing silly faces while splashing nearby crops! You need to help me deal with this.
zh: 有几个在那儿又蹦又跳、做鬼脸，还把水溅到旁边的庄稼上！你得帮我对付一下。

keys: Some other guards have already gone ahead. Ask Watchman Dausen outside of the gates and he will tell you where to go.
en: Some other guards have already gone ahead. Ask Watchman Dausen outside of the gates and he will tell you where to go.
zh: 其他一些守卫已经先行出发了。去问问城门外的守卫道森，他会告诉你去哪儿。

keys: Sorry, I don't get many visitors. Not since I used to be a counsellor up in the palace.
en: Sorry, I don't get many visitors. Not since I used to be a counsellor up in the palace.
zh: 抱歉，我没什么访客。自从我不在宫里当参事后就更是如此。

keys: Sorry. My bad.
en: Sorry. My bad.
zh: 抱歉，我的错。

keys: Soul Menhirs are ancient monoliths carved from massive blocks of Zielite, once erected by the Kahwe, known as druids around here, to channel and radiate Mana.
en: Soul Menhirs are ancient monoliths carved from massive blocks of Zielite, once erected by the Kahwe, known as druids around here, to channel and radiate Mana.
zh: 灵魂石碑是古老的巨石，由大块的泽利石雕成，昔日由卡威——在这附近被称作德鲁伊——竖立起来，用以引导和散发魔力。

keys: Speaking of which. What about Nickos? Did you find him?
en: Speaking of which. What about Nickos? Did you find him?
zh: 说到这个，尼科斯怎么样了？你找到他了吗？

keys: Sprinting drains stamina, so use it when you need it.
en: Sprinting drains stamina, so use it when you need it.
zh: 冲刺会消耗体力，需要时再用。

keys: Stamina governs how long you can sprint and perform physical actions before tiring.
en: Stamina governs how long you can sprint and perform physical actions before tiring.
zh: 体力决定你能冲刺和进行体力活动多久才会疲劳。

keys: Stand clear of the gate. Move along.
en: Stand clear of the gate. Move along.
zh: 离城门远点。走吧走吧。

keys: Start with the peyotes in that field just north from here.
en: Start with the peyotes in that field just north from here.
zh: 从北边那片田里的佩奥特仙人掌开始。

keys: Stay as long as you like and please do come visit us and come say hi on our Discord.
en: Stay as long as you like and please do come visit us and come say hi on our Discord.
zh: 想待多久都行，也请常来看我们，到我们的 Discord 上打个招呼。

keys: Stick to the paths if you have to go. Better yet, don't.
en: Stick to the paths if you have to go. Better yet, don't.
zh: 真要走就走大路。最好还是别走。

keys: Still at it? Those corridors aren't friendly.
en: Still at it? Those corridors aren't friendly.
zh: 还在折腾呢？那些走廊可不太友好。

keys: Still short, by my eye. %d of each material. Anything less and the mix won't work.
en: Still short, by my eye. %d of each material. Anything less and the mix won't work.
zh: 依我看还不够。每种材料各差 %d。少一点也不行，混合就不会成功。

keys: Still thinking... Good players take their time!
en: Still thinking... Good players take their time!
zh: 还在想呢……好的牌手从不着急！

keys: Strength increases your physical damage, walk speed and carrying capacity.
en: Strength increases your physical damage, walk speed and carrying capacity.
zh: 力量提高你的物理伤害、行走速度和负重能力。

keys: Strike first.
en: Strike first.
zh: 先出手。

keys: Suit yourself. The furnace keeps burning either way.
en: Suit yourself. The furnace keeps burning either way.
zh: 随你便。反正炉子一直烧着。

keys: Sulphur is trickier. The fire goblins out by the sandstorm carry it. I think that their body makes it. Maybe to produce their fire?
en: Sulphur is trickier. The fire goblins out by the sandstorm carry it. I think that their body makes it. Maybe to produce their fire?
zh: 硫磺比较麻烦。沙暴那边外的火哥布林身上带着。我猜是它们身体产生的，也许是为了喷火？

keys: Take the Kano, the Mana Seed.
en: Take the Kano, the Mana Seed.
zh: 收下这颗卡诺，魔力之种。

keys: Take these goggles and boots. The sand will burn your feet and get in your eyes out there!
en: Take these goggles and boots. The sand will burn your feet and get in your eyes out there!
zh: 拿上这副护目镜和这双靴子。在外面沙子会烫伤你的脚、迷进你的眼睛！

keys: Take this envelope back to him. He'll know what's inside.
en: Take this envelope back to him. He'll know what's inside.
zh: 把这封信封带回去给他。里面是什么他心里有数。

keys: Take your time. The furnace is not going anywhere and neither am I.
en: Take your time. The furnace is not going anywhere and neither am I.
zh: 慢慢来。炉子跑不了，我也跑不了。

keys: Tell him what you did for Kael he will know what to do with you next.
en: Tell him what you did for Kael he will know what to do with you next.
zh: 告诉他你为卡埃尔做了什么，他自会知道接下来怎么安排你。

keys: Thank you for getting me that water. Maybe now I can relax a bit and take my time on the way back.
en: Thank you for getting me that water. Maybe now I can relax a bit and take my time on the way back.
zh: 谢谢你给我弄来水。也许现在我可以放松一下，慢慢往回走了。

keys: Thank you for your help. I'll get to work on making new healing potions right away!
en: Thank you for your help. I'll get to work on making new healing potions right away!
zh: 谢谢你的帮助。我马上就开始制作新的治疗药水！

keys: Thank you! I feel much better. I'll rest here for a bit and then make my way out of this place.
en: Thank you! I feel much better. I'll rest here for a bit and then make my way out of this place.
zh: 谢谢你！我感觉好多了。我在这儿歇一会儿，然后就离开这个地方。

keys: Thank you, friend! It's good to have some relief, finally!
en: Thank you, friend! It's good to have some relief, finally!
zh: 谢谢你，朋友！总算能松口气了！

keys: Thank you, here you go!
en: Thank you, here you go!
zh: 谢谢，给你！

keys: Thank you, really.
en: Thank you, really.
zh: 真的谢谢你。

keys: Thank you.
en: Thank you.
zh: 谢谢。

keys: Thanks for saving me! I was worried that the man would come back to finish me.
en: Thanks for saving me! I was worried that the man would come back to finish me.
zh: 多谢救命之恩！我还担心那人会回来补刀呢。

keys: That is very kind of you. I would not normally ask, but a croissant would be absolutely wonderful right now.
en: That is very kind of you. I would not normally ask, but a croissant would be absolutely wonderful right now.
zh: 你真是太好了。我平时不会开口，但现在来一个牛角面包就再好不过了。

keys: That northern part is your best bet for anything you could need, markets, games, the lot.
en: That northern part is your best bet for anything you could need, markets, games, the lot.
zh: 北边那块最能满足你的需求，市场、游戏，应有尽有。

keys: That was exactly what I needed. You have no idea.
en: That was exactly what I needed. You have no idea.
zh: 那正是我需要的。你根本想象不到。

keys: That was years ago. I still think about it more than I should.
en: That was years ago. I still think about it more than I should.
zh: 那是好几年前的事了。我至今想它想得比该想的还多。

keys: That's an understatement!
en: That's an understatement!
zh: 这说法还太保守了！

keys: That's fine. I will just need to rest here a bit and then I'll be able to make my way out of this place.
en: That's fine. I will just need to rest here a bit and then I'll be able to make my way out of this place.
zh: 没关系。我只需在这儿歇一会儿，然后就能离开这个地方了。

keys: That's not ideal as that sandstorm keeps getting bigger year after year.
en: That's not ideal as that sandstorm keeps getting bigger year after year.
zh: 这可不妙，那场沙暴一年比一年大。

keys: That's the Red Queen's castle.
en: That's the Red Queen's castle.
zh: 那是红发女王的城堡。

keys: The Age of Kaore changed them. This type of maggot grew very large and very plentiful. Other creatures were changed in worse ways.
en: The Age of Kaore changed them. This type of maggot grew very large and very plentiful. Other creatures were changed in worse ways.
zh: 考雷纪元改变了它们。这种蛆虫长得巨大无比、数量繁多。其他生物被改变得更糟糕。

keys: The Hantu, or Mana trees as they are also known, were the pillars of Mana in our world.
en: The Hantu, or Mana trees as they are also known, were the pillars of Mana in our world.
zh: 汉图，也称魔力树，曾是我们世界魔力的支柱。

keys: The Kahwe carry on the knowledge of times when Mana was a harmonious force of good in our world. We seek to restore the balance that was lost when the Uru were destroyed.
en: The Kahwe carry on the knowledge of times when Mana was a harmonious force of good in our world. We seek to restore the balance that was lost when the Uru were destroyed.
zh: 卡威们传承着魔力在我们世界尚为和谐的善之力量那个时代的知识。我们力求恢复魔力树被毁后失去的平衡。

keys: The Kingdom however officially follows the Savean Creed. They believe, like half of the people around you, that Mana is also a corrupting force just like Kaore and that both should be avoided unless strictly necessary.
en: The Kingdom however officially follows the Savean Creed. They believe, like half of the people around you, that Mana is also a corrupting force just like Kaore and that both should be avoided unless strictly necessary.
zh: 不过王国官方信奉萨万信条。他们和你身边一半的人一样，认为魔力也像考雷一样是一种腐蚀性的力量，两者都应回避，除非万不得已。

keys: The Mana Trees were destroyed many years ago after a devastating war where the Savean Creed took hold among the ruling elites of Aemil.
en: The Mana Trees were destroyed many years ago after a devastating war where the Savean Creed took hold among the ruling elites of Aemil.
zh: 魔力树在许多年前被毁，那是一场毁灭性的战争之后，萨万信条在艾米尔的统治精英中占据了上风。

keys: The Manayir Order are the ones who announced the end of the Age of Kaore about 27 years ago.
en: The Manayir Order are the ones who announced the end of the Age of Kaore about 27 years ago.
zh: 玛纳伊尔教团正是约 27 年前宣布考雷纪元终结的一方。

keys: The Queen happened. Or kept happening I guess. Always more demands, always her way.
en: The Queen happened. Or kept happening I guess. Always more demands, always her way.
zh: 女王干的。或者说一直这么干吧。要求越来越多，什么都要依她。

keys: The Sun is getting to me.
en: The Sun is getting to me.
zh: 太阳快把我晒化了。

keys: The Zuni tribes of Tonori never recognised our Kingdom so she really only rules over the city.
en: The Zuni tribes of Tonori never recognised our Kingdom so she really only rules over the city.
zh: 托诺里的祖尼部落从不承认我们的王国，所以她其实只统治着这座城市。

keys: The \"Red Queen\", more formally known as Queen Karolina I, is the useless ruler of this city.
en: The \"Red Queen\", more formally known as Queen Karolina I, is the useless ruler of this city.
zh: 那位"红发女王"，正式称呼是卡罗琳娜一世女王，是这座城市无能的统治者。

keys: The action bar lets you slot skills and items for quick access. Drag what you need most onto it as, in combat, every second counts.
en: The action bar lets you slot skills and items for quick access. Drag what you need most onto it as, in combat, every second counts.
zh: 动作栏可以放置技能和物品以便快速使用。把最常用的拖上去吧，战斗中分秒必争。

keys: The cave here has an underground pond of very fresh and pure water.
en: The cave here has an underground pond of very fresh and pure water.
zh: 这个洞穴里有一个地下池塘，水质非常清冽纯净。

keys: The city walls close off the city between the valley and the open sea.
en: The city walls close off the city between the valley and the open sea.
zh: 城墙把城市封闭在山谷与大海之间。

keys: The community is very close-knit.
en: The community is very close-knit.
zh: 社区非常紧密。

keys: The corridors are patrolled, though. You should stick to the shadows. If you step into the light, the guards will catch you.
en: The corridors are patrolled, though. You should stick to the shadows. If you step into the light, the guards will catch you.
zh: 不过走廊有人巡逻。你得贴着阴影走。一旦踏进光亮，守卫就会抓住你。

keys: The decision was made to destroy the Uru and attempt to create a world without Mana.
en: The decision was made to destroy the Uru and attempt to create a world without Mana.
zh: 于是众人决定毁掉魔力树，尝试创造一个没有魔力的世界。

keys: The druid Nina of Tulimshar is someone I know you can trust with it. She is very attuned to the flow of Mana and I have come to know her presence.
en: The druid Nina of Tulimshar is someone I know you can trust with it. She is very attuned to the flow of Mana and I have come to know her presence.
zh: 图利姆沙的德鲁伊妮娜是我知道可以托付的人。她对魔力的流动极为敏锐，我熟悉她的气息。

keys: The greatest city in the world, if you ask me. The atmosphere, the people, the wine...
en: The greatest city in the world, if you ask me. The atmosphere, the people, the wine...
zh: 世上最伟大的城市，至少我是这么认为。这里的气氛、这里的人、这里的酒……

keys: The kingdom pulled out of this land a long time ago. Said it was not worth keeping.
en: The kingdom pulled out of this land a long time ago. Said it was not worth keeping.
zh: 王国很久以前就撤出了这片土地。说不值得守着。

keys: The mages over at the tower... The Manayir. They've issued the warning that Kaore is currently concentrating in dangerous patterns throughout Tonori.
en: The mages over at the tower... The Manayir. They've issued the warning that Kaore is currently concentrating in dangerous patterns throughout Tonori.
zh: 塔里那群法师……玛纳伊尔。他们发出警告说，考雷目前正在托诺里全境以危险的模式聚集。

keys: The maggots love feeding on the cactus. Even though these maggots are unusually large, their mouths are still small and agile enough to eat their way around any spikes.
en: The maggots love feeding on the cactus. Even though these maggots are unusually large, their mouths are still small and agile enough to eat their way around any spikes.
zh: 这些蛆虫最爱吃仙人掌。虽然它们体型出奇地大，嘴巴却依然小巧灵活，能绕开尖刺啃食。

keys: The menu gives you access to your inventory, skills, quests, settings and more. Use it to manage everything you carry and know.
en: The menu gives you access to your inventory, skills, quests, settings and more. Use it to manage everything you carry and know.
zh: 菜单可以打开你的物品栏、技能、任务、设置等等。用它管理你携带和知晓的一切。

keys: The mines used to be a rich source of Iron Ore, very lucrative business for the Red Queen since the whole area is her private property.
en: The mines used to be a rich source of Iron Ore, very lucrative business for the Red Queen since the whole area is her private property.
zh: 这矿洞曾经盛产铁矿，对红发女王来说是一桩非常赚钱的生意，因为整个区域都是她的私产。

keys: The most notable feature is the peninsula that extends from the beach.
en: The most notable feature is the peninsula that extends from the beach.
zh: 最显眼的是从海滩延伸出去的那个半岛。

keys: The next time I heard something it turned out to be you walking towards me.
en: The next time I heard something it turned out to be you walking towards me.
zh: 下次再听到动静，结果是你朝我走来。

keys: The offer stands whenever you're ready.
en: The offer stands whenever you're ready.
zh: 随时恭候，你准备好了就行。

keys: The old man had no other kids and took a liking to him. Before dying he named him his heir. He was actually a very smart man and a good leader so the palace folk just went with it.
en: The old man had no other kids and took a liking to him. Before dying he named him his heir. He was actually a very smart man and a good leader so the palace folk just went with it.
zh: 那老头没有别的孩子，而且很喜欢他。临终前指定他为继承人。他确实是个聪明人，也是个好领袖，所以宫里的人也就认了。

keys: The people who built this world are still working on what comes next. You have caught up to them.
en: The people who built this world are still working on what comes next. You have caught up to them.
zh: 创造这个世界的人仍在做接下来的事。你已经赶上他们了。

keys: The person you just fought was after my Kano. You would call it a Mana Seed.
en: The person you just fought was after my Kano. You would call it a Mana Seed.
zh: 刚才和你交手的人是为了我的卡诺。你们会管它叫魔力之种。

keys: The pond is deep inside the cave. The best way to find it is to get lost, you'll see it eventually.
en: The pond is deep inside the cave. The best way to find it is to get lost, you'll see it eventually.
zh: 池塘在洞穴深处。最好的找法就是迷路，走着走着你自然会看到。

keys: The port is where most goods come in from outside Tonori.
en: The port is where most goods come in from outside Tonori.
zh: 港口是从托诺里以外进货最多的地方。

keys: The progress window will group all your on-going quests and monster encounters.
en: The progress window will group all your on-going quests and monster encounters.
zh: 进度窗口会汇总你所有进行中的任务和怪物遭遇。

keys: The road ends here, for now.
en: The road ends here, for now.
zh: 这条路到这儿就断了，暂时如此。

keys: The rules are simple. I should know, I made them!
en: The rules are simple. I should know, I made them!
zh: 规则很简单。我该清楚，规则就是定的！

keys: The sand is everywhere, as you can see, but the other components are harder to come by.
en: The sand is everywhere, as you can see, but the other components are harder to come by.
zh: 沙子到处都是，你也看到了，但其他成分就难得多了。

keys: The sandstorm ate all of it and forced us to barricade ourselves at the end of the valley.
en: The sandstorm ate all of it and forced us to barricade ourselves at the end of the valley.
zh: 沙暴吞掉了一切，我们被迫退到山谷尽头自守。

keys: The wall you see around us keeps the desert out from wildness and protects us from that southern sandstorm.
en: The wall you see around us keeps the desert out from wildness and protects us from that southern sandstorm.
zh: 我们周围的这堵墙把沙漠挡在外面，也保护我们免受南边那场沙暴的侵袭。

keys: Then south? Or maybe I went further to the east then north again...
en: Then south? Or maybe I went further to the east then north again...
zh: 那后来是往南了？或者我可能再往东走了，然后又往北……

keys: Then the Queen kept pushing. More demands, always her way. No room to just do the work.
en: Then the Queen kept pushing. More demands, always her way. No room to just do the work.
zh: 然后女王不断施压。要求越来越多，什么都要依她。根本没有安心做事的空间。

keys: Then, they founded an order called Manayir somewhere nearby, to study and use the flow of Mana close to my roots.
en: Then, they founded an order called Manayir somewhere nearby, to study and use the flow of Mana close to my roots.
zh: 之后，他们在附近某处创立了名为玛纳伊尔的教团，在我根系附近研究并运用魔力的流动。

keys: Then, we add calcium. That's the bones, crushed into a powder. This is essential so that the glass does not melt when in contact with water.
en: Then, we add calcium. That's the bones, crushed into a powder. This is essential so that the glass does not melt when in contact with water.
zh: 然后我们加入钙，就是把骨头磨成的粉。这很关键，这样玻璃接触水时才不会熔化。

keys: There is a well just outside of here, maybe there was underground water nearby.
en: There is a well just outside of here, maybe there was underground water nearby.
zh: 外面不远处有一口井，也许附近曾有地下水。

keys: There must be a crack in the walls somewhere below this ledge. That's where he disappeared.
en: There must be a crack in the walls somewhere below this ledge. That's where he disappeared.
zh: 这岩壁下方某处一定有条裂缝。他就是从那儿消失的。

keys: There was someone I worked with. Ben. Brilliant man. Could fix anything, build anything.
en: There was someone I worked with. Ben. Brilliant man. Could fix anything, build anything.
zh: 我曾有个共事的人，本。才华出众，什么都能修，什么都能造。

keys: There's a passage behind the library next to me. Goes outside the walls. Not many know about it.
en: There's a passage behind the library next to me. Goes outside the walls. Not many know about it.
zh: 我旁边的图书馆后面有条通道，通到城墙外。知道的人不多。

keys: There's a well here, but it's been dry for a long time.
en: There's a well here, but it's been dry for a long time.
zh: 这儿有口井，但早就干涸了。

keys: There's an artisan in Tulimshar who makes these from palm fibers and a cactus-derived resin. Strong stuff. The quenchiest.
en: There's an artisan in Tulimshar who makes these from palm fibers and a cactus-derived resin. Strong stuff. The quenchiest.
zh: 图利姆沙有位匠人用棕榈纤维和仙人掌提炼的树脂做这种东西。非常结实，最禁得住泡。

keys: There's an envelope on that shelf. Letters we wrote each other, back when the Queen had us stationed apart. Before everything went wrong.
en: There's an envelope on that shelf. Letters we wrote each other, back when the Queen had us stationed apart. Before everything went wrong.
zh: 那个架子上有个信封。是我们当年写给彼此的信，那时女王把我们分派到两地。在一败涂地之前。

keys: These are not venomous snakes, but they are aggressive and there are so many...
en: These are not venomous snakes, but they are aggressive and there are so many...
zh: 这些蛇没有毒，但很凶，而且数量实在太多……

keys: These are old. Back when the Queen had us stationed apart, before we even shared the same wall.
en: These are old. Back when the Queen had us stationed apart, before we even shared the same wall.
zh: 这些都是旧物了。那时女王把我们分派两地，我们甚至还没共用同一堵墙。

keys: These are your vital resources. Keep an eye on them at all times.
en: These are your vital resources. Keep an eye on them at all times.
zh: 这些是你的生命资源。随时留意它们。

keys: These days in the desert were my happiest but I think it's time for me to go back to civilization now.
en: These days in the desert were my happiest but I think it's time for me to go back to civilization now.
zh: 在沙漠里的这些日子是我最快乐的时光，不过我想是时候回到文明世界了。

keys: They are a powerful organisation of wise mages and experts of Mana. They have been around for a very long time, almost as long as my people.
en: They are a powerful organisation of wise mages and experts of Mana. They have been around for a very long time, almost as long as my people.
zh: 他们是一个由睿智法师和魔力专家组成的强大组织。他们存在了很久，几乎和我的族人一样久。

keys: They built a castle into a small peninsula, all the way across the beach on west side of the Tulimshar Valley, past the storm.
en: They built a castle into a small peninsula, all the way across the beach on west side of the Tulimshar Valley, past the storm.
zh: 他们在图利姆沙谷西侧的沙滩尽头、越过风暴的地方，在一座小半岛上建起了一座城堡。

keys: They connected all living things through the flow of Mana. Each one kept the land around it alive and prevented Mana from decaying into Kaore.
en: They connected all living things through the flow of Mana. Each one kept the land around it alive and prevented Mana from decaying into Kaore.
zh: 它们通过魔力的流转将所有生灵连接在一起。每一棵都让它周围的土地保持生机，并阻止魔力腐化为卡奥尔。

keys: They have lived in the Tonori desert for a very long time. In fact, they still tell stories of this land before it was even a desert.
en: They have lived in the Tonori desert for a very long time. In fact, they still tell stories of this land before it was even a desert.
zh: 他们已经在托诺里沙漠生活了非常久的时间。事实上，他们至今仍在讲述这片土地还没变成沙漠之前的故事。

keys: They just taunt people by jumping around and splashing crops near them...
en: They just taunt people by jumping around and splashing crops near them...
zh: 它们只是靠蹦蹦跳跳、把水溅到人们旁边的庄稼上来戏弄人……

keys: They look so funny, but she doesn't like when I laugh at them, so she always wants to be the X.
en: They look so funny, but she doesn't like when I laugh at them, so she always wants to be the X.
zh: 它们看起来太滑稽了，可是她不喜欢我笑话它们，所以她总想当那个X。

keys: They say that squirrels used to be as intelligent as people, but they simply lost all that over time.
en: They say that squirrels used to be as intelligent as people, but they simply lost all that over time.
zh: 据说松鼠曾经和人类一样聪明，但它们只是随着时间推移把这些都弄丢了。

keys: They say they weren't always like this. I'm not old enough to remember, no one is anymore.
en: They say they weren't always like this. I'm not old enough to remember, no one is anymore.
zh: 他们说他们并非一直是这样。我还不够老，记不得那时候的事，如今也没有人记得了。

keys: They're all useful and important... except maybe for Silvio. He's just here to drink and flirt with Julia, that old drunk!
en: They're all useful and important... except maybe for Silvio. He's just here to drink and flirt with Julia, that old drunk!
zh: 他们个个都有用、都重要……也许除了西尔维奥。他待在这儿就只是喝酒，还有和朱莉娅调情，这个老酒鬼！

keys: They're called that for a reason, you know? That area of the desert is prone to strong winds and the swirling sands tend to make it difficult to get to.
en: They're called that for a reason, you know? That area of the desert is prone to strong winds and the swirling sands tend to make it difficult to get to.
zh: 这名字可不是白叫的，你知道吗？沙漠的那片区域常有强风，卷起的流沙让人很难抵达那里。

keys: They're kaore-infused cacti, harmless to us but useless for farming now.
en: They're kaore-infused cacti, harmless to us but useless for farming now.
zh: 它们是浸染了卡奥尔之力的仙人掌，对我们无害，但现在已经没法用来耕种了。

keys: They're some ancient order that studies Mana and does who-knows-what-else with it, up in that tower to the west of the city.
en: They're some ancient order that studies Mana and does who-knows-what-else with it, up in that tower to the west of the city.
zh: 他们是某个研究魔法的古老团体，还用它做着天知道别的什么，就在城西边那座塔里。

keys: They're the ones who issue warnings about Kaore.
en: They're the ones who issue warnings about Kaore.
zh: 发布卡奥尔相关警报的就是他们。

keys: They've always traded with Tulimshar and are mostly friendly towards us, but only as long as we don't send our soldiers too far outside our walls.
en: They've always traded with Tulimshar and are mostly friendly towards us, but only as long as we don't send our soldiers too far outside our walls.
zh: 他们一直与图利姆沙做生意，对我们大体友好——但前提是我们不把士兵派到城墙外太远的地方。

keys: They've been abandonded for a long time, but I just saw a group of people heading in that direction earlier.
en: They've been abandonded for a long time, but I just saw a group of people heading in that direction earlier.
zh: 那里已经被废弃很久了，不过我之前刚看见一群人朝那个方向去了。

keys: They've been abandoned for a few years now as the sandstorm intensified, that area got more dangerous to traverse and miners were dying either to the sand storms or to the angry creatures that wander the desert.
en: They've been abandoned for a few years now as the sandstorm intensified, that area got more dangerous to traverse and miners were dying either to the sand storms or to the angry creatures that wander the desert.
zh: 随着沙暴愈演愈烈，那里已经被废弃好几年了，穿越那片区域变得越来越危险，矿工们不是死于沙暴，就是死于在沙漠里游荡的暴躁生物。

keys: This creates a bond between your soul and the Menhir. Should something happen to you, the Menhir acts as an anchor.
en: This creates a bond between your soul and the Menhir. Should something happen to you, the Menhir acts as an anchor.
zh: 这会在你的灵魂与石碑之间建立一种联结。万一你遭遇不测，石碑就会作为你的锚点。

keys: This envelope. It's heavy.
en: This envelope. It's heavy.
zh: 这个信封。很沉。

keys: This is a bad time for you Tulimshar folk to intrude on this place.
en: This is a bad time for you Tulimshar folk to intrude on this place.
zh: 你们图利姆沙的人挑这种时候闯进这地方，可真不是时候。

keys: This particular storm is different though. It's unusually intense, hot and long-lasting. I wonder if something out there is causing it...
en: This particular storm is different though. It's unusually intense, hot and long-lasting. I wonder if something out there is causing it...
zh: 不过这次的沙暴有些不同。它异常猛烈、灼热而持久。我在想是不是外面有什么东西在作祟……

keys: This place doesn't feel right.
en: This place doesn't feel right.
zh: 这地方让人觉得不太对劲。

keys: This quickly spread to many cultures and it became customary to cut down the Uru to limit the flow of Mana.
en: This quickly spread to many cultures and it became customary to cut down the Uru to limit the flow of Mana.
zh: 这很快就传播到许多文化之中，砍伐魔力树以限制魔力流动渐渐成了惯例。

keys: This water is filthy! You do not think this is the pond Mauro had in mind.
en: This water is filthy! You do not think this is the pond Mauro had in mind.
zh: 这水太脏了！我想这不是毛罗心里想的那个池塘。

keys: Though once abundant, Zielite has become scarce due to the purge that took place when the Savean Creed turned society against the use of Mana.
en: Though once abundant, Zielite has become scarce due to the purge that took place when the Savean Creed turned society against the use of Mana.
zh: 泽利石虽然曾经十分丰富，但在萨维安信条让整个社会转而反对使用魔力的大清洗之后，它变得稀缺起来。

keys: To repay your debt toward the city and if you really want to leave this place I will enlist you to an expedition outside the city.
en: To repay your debt toward the city and if you really want to leave this place I will enlist you to an expedition outside the city.
zh: 为了偿还你对这座城欠下的债，也如果你真想离开这里，我会把你编入城外的一支远征队。

keys: Tough break. The cards are fickle, but they always come back around.
en: Tough break. The cards are fickle, but they always come back around.
zh: 运气真差。纸牌这东西反复无常，但它们总会转回来的。

keys: Truth be told, all I remember are the snakes and their sharp bites. Thankfully this kind doesn't have venom.
en: Truth be told, all I remember are the snakes and their sharp bites. Thankfully this kind doesn't have venom.
zh: 说实话，我记得的只有那些蛇和它们厉害的咬痕。幸好这种蛇没有毒。

keys: Tulimshar Valley is a low-lying protected area where the city of Tulimshar hides from the open Tonori Desert.
en: Tulimshar Valley is a low-lying protected area where the city of Tulimshar hides from the open Tonori Desert.
zh: 图利姆沙山谷是一片低洼的庇护之地，图利姆沙城就藏在其中，避开开阔的托诺里沙漠。

keys: Tulimshar sits in the valley that lies between our eastern and western hills.
en: Tulimshar sits in the valley that lies between our eastern and western hills.
zh: 图利姆沙坐落在我们东边和西边两片丘陵之间的山谷里。

keys: Until it takes a full hold on them, then they become sort of undead too. It's really a nasty curse.
en: Until it takes a full hold on them, then they become sort of undead too. It's really a nasty curse.
zh: 直到它完全控制他们，那时他们也就变得有点像亡者了。这真是一种恶毒的诅咒。

keys: Until then, Manayir and the Tonori region is yours to continue to explore.
en: Until then, Manayir and the Tonori region is yours to continue to explore.
zh: 在那之前，玛纳伊尔和托诺里地区就任由你继续探索了。

keys: Uru, also known as Mana Trees, used to be the heart of the world's lifeforce, acting as a natural conductor for Mana energy.
en: Uru, also known as Mana Trees, used to be the heart of the world's lifeforce, acting as a natural conductor for Mana energy.
zh: 乌卢，又称魔力树，曾经是世界生命力的核心，充当着魔力能量的天然导体。

keys: Use Interact near an NPC to talk to them. You can also use Target to select one first.
en: Use Interact near an NPC to talk to them. You can also use Target to select one first.
zh: 在NPC附近使用互动键即可与其交谈。你也可以先用锁定键选中一个。

keys: Victory is yours! Well done, the cards favoured you today.
en: Victory is yours! Well done, the cards favoured you today.
zh: 胜利属于你！干得漂亮，今天纸牌眷顾了你。

keys: Vitality raises your health pool, regeneration and global defense.
en: Vitality raises your health pool, regeneration and global defense.
zh: 活力提升你的生命值上限、回复能力和全局防御。

keys: Wait, where did the envelope go? Bring it back to me.
en: Wait, where did the envelope go? Bring it back to me.
zh: 等等，信封去哪儿了？把它给我拿回来。

keys: Walking away mid-game? In my day, that'd cost you a round of drinks.
en: Walking away mid-game? In my day, that'd cost you a round of drinks.
zh: 玩到一半就走？在我那个年代，这可得罚你请一轮酒。

keys: Wanna play tic-tac-toe?
en: Wanna play tic-tac-toe?
zh: 想玩井字棋吗？

keys: Wanna play?
en: Wanna play?
zh: 想玩吗？

keys: Watchman Ekinu is stationed at the gates south from here.
en: Watchman Ekinu is stationed at the gates south from here.
zh: 守卫埃基努驻守在从这里往南的城门口。

keys: Watchman Kael is currently in charge of the local patrol from within our wall, you should speak to him if you're looking for work.
en: Watchman Kael is currently in charge of the local patrol from within our wall, you should speak to him if you're looking for work.
zh: 守卫凯尔目前负责城墙以内的本地巡逻，如果你想找活儿干，应该去找他谈谈。

keys: Watchman Kael is stationed east of here, by one of the cactus farms.
en: Watchman Kael is stationed east of here, by one of the cactus farms.
zh: 守卫凯尔驻守在从这里往东的一处仙人掌农场旁。

keys: Water is a dangerous force of nature too if you think about it, but no one is suggesting to close the wells.
en: Water is a dangerous force of nature too if you think about it, but no one is suggesting to close the wells.
zh: 你想想，水其实也是一种危险的自然之力，可没人因此提议把井都封了。

keys: We also had a presence in Tulimshar for a long time. Tried to keep Mana from being made into a matter of politics. That time is also behind us.
en: We also had a presence in Tulimshar for a long time. Tried to keep Mana from being made into a matter of politics. That time is also behind us.
zh: 我们也曾在图利姆沙长期驻留，试图阻止魔力沦为政治的工具。那个时代也已经过去了。

keys: We are Kahwe. An order of druids gathered to research, teach and protect the order of Mana in our world.
en: We are Kahwe. An order of druids gathered to research, teach and protect the order of Mana in our world.
zh: 我们是卡维。一个由德鲁伊组成的团体，聚集在一起研究、传授并守护我们世界中魔力的秩序。

keys: We are currently enjoying a well earned break far from cold weathers, as we've spent the last few weeks up north in the Kaizei region.
en: We are currently enjoying a well earned break far from cold weathers, as we've spent the last few weeks up north in the Kaizei region.
zh: 我们刚刚在北方的凯泽地区待了几个星期，现在正在远离严寒的地方享受一场来之不易的休整。

keys: We are living in the desert cliff, west from here. The road is not open to outsiders.
en: We are living in the desert cliff, west from here. The road is not open to outsiders.
zh: 我们住在从这里往西的沙漠峭壁上。那条路不对外开放。

keys: We are sailing towards Candor soon, but in the meantime we can go for a short trip wherever you want.
en: We are sailing towards Candor soon, but in the meantime we can go for a short trip wherever you want.
zh: 我们很快就要启航前往坎多，不过在那之前，你想去哪儿我们都可以带你短途航行一趟。

keys: We are standing before Tulimshar's ancient Soul Menhir. I am its guardian and use its powers to protect the people of this city, or as much as I am allowed to.
en: We are standing before Tulimshar's ancient Soul Menhir. I am its guardian and use its powers to protect the people of this city, or as much as I am allowed to.
zh: 我们正站在图利姆沙古老的灵魂石碑前。我是它的守护者，借助它的力量保护这座城的人民——至少在我被允许的范围内。

keys: We call it Nawah in our language. It's where the Manayir Order makes their home.
en: We call it Nawah in our language. It's where the Manayir Order makes their home.
zh: 在我们的语言里我们叫它纳瓦。那是玛纳伊尔法师团的家园。

keys: We complain about maggots and peyotes, but really we have it easy compared to what my parents lived through.
en: We complain about maggots and peyotes, but really we have it easy compared to what my parents lived through.
zh: 我们总抱怨蛆虫和仙人掌果，可与我父母经历过的岁月相比，我们的日子其实算轻松的。

keys: We do need one more fighter and I was worried about taking too many guards away from their posts here in the city.
en: We do need one more fighter and I was worried about taking too many guards away from their posts here in the city.
zh: 我们的确还缺一名战士，而我又担心从城里抽调太多守卫、让他们离开岗位。

keys: We held these walls together for years. Under the Queen, that's no small thing.
en: We held these walls together for years. Under the Queen, that's no small thing.
zh: 这些年是我们一起守住了这些城墙。在女王麾下，这可不是小事。

keys: We make our glass from the sand of Tonori. We also use salt, bones and sulphur powder.
en: We make our glass from the sand of Tonori. We also use salt, bones and sulphur powder.
zh: 我们用托诺里的沙子制玻璃，还会用到盐、骨头和硫磺粉。

keys: We mostly stay within that area, most people live and work in the central district which spreads between here and the port to the north.
en: We mostly stay within that area, most people live and work in the central district which spreads between here and the port to the north.
zh: 我们大多待在那片区域，大多数人都在中心区生活和工作，它从这里一直延伸到北边的港口。

keys: We named our ship La Johanne. After its previous captain. I know you're not supposed to rename a ship, but I did almost rebuild it after all.
en: We named our ship La Johanne. After its previous captain. I know you're not supposed to rename a ship, but I did almost rebuild it after all.
zh: 我们给船取名拉·约翰娜号，用的是它前任船长的名字。我知道按规矩不该给船改名，可毕竟是我亲手把它几乎重建了一遍。

keys: We should not mess with flooded caves. The tunnels could collapse and trap us all inside. I'll report back that the mine is too far gone.
en: We should not mess with flooded caves. The tunnels could collapse and trap us all inside. I'll report back that the mine is too far gone.
zh: 我们不该招惹被淹没的洞穴。隧道可能会坍塌，把我们全都困在里面。我会回去汇报这座矿已经没救了。

keys: We trade with them occasionally and we have always shared our knowledge and admiration of The Spirit - Mana - with them.
en: We trade with them occasionally and we have always shared our knowledge and admiration of The Spirit - Mana - with them.
zh: 我们偶尔与他们交易，并且一直与他们分享我们对圣灵——也就是魔力——的认识与敬仰。

keys: We try to help each other and it's great to have people who care about each other's interests.
en: We try to help each other and it's great to have people who care about each other's interests.
zh: 我们尽力互相帮助，能有彼此在意对方利益的人真好。

keys: We use salt to bring down the melting temperature, so that it's not too hot for our clay pots.
en: We use salt to bring down the melting temperature, so that it's not too hot for our clay pots.
zh: 我们用盐来降低熔化温度，这样温度就不会太高，免得烧坏我们的陶锅。

keys: We were both trying to keep the same walls standing. But somewhere along the way we stopped talking about it and started fighting about it instead.
en: We were both trying to keep the same walls standing. But somewhere along the way we stopped talking about it and started fighting about it instead.
zh: 我们本来都在努力守住同一片城墙。但不知从什么时候起，我们不再为此交谈，反而开始为此争斗。

keys: We were their guardians. We failed at that.
en: We were their guardians. We failed at that.
zh: 我们曾是他们的守护者。我们失职了。

keys: We will keep relying on the much safer wells inside the city. I guess this water belongs to the snakes now.
en: We will keep relying on the much safer wells inside the city. I guess this water belongs to the snakes now.
zh: 我们会继续依靠城里安全得多的水井。我想这潭水现在归蛇了。

keys: We will meet again...
en: We will meet again...
zh: 我们还会再见的……

keys: We're going on a small expedition into the desert soon and you might be the right type of person to help us out.
en: We're going on a small expedition into the desert soon and you might be the right type of person to help us out.
zh: 我们很快要进入沙漠进行一次小型远征，而你也许正是能帮上忙的那种人。

keys: We're not going to get his body. Don't even suggest it.
en: We're not going to get his body. Don't even suggest it.
zh: 我们不可能把他的遗体带回来。连提都别提。

keys: Welcome aboard, or close enough.
en: Welcome aboard, or close enough.
zh: 欢迎登船——差不多算是登船了。

keys: Welcome back. What can I do for you?
en: Welcome back. What can I do for you?
zh: 欢迎回来。有什么我能为你效劳的吗？

keys: Welcome to Manayir.
en: Welcome to Manayir.
zh: 欢迎来到玛纳伊尔。

keys: Welcome, welcome! Are you here for a game of cards?
en: Welcome, welcome! Are you here for a game of cards?
zh: 欢迎，欢迎！你是来玩牌的吗？

keys: Well, it's good to have you here. The city needs capable people to help keep it safe.
en: Well, it's good to have you here. The city needs capable people to help keep it safe.
zh: 嗯，很高兴你来了。这座城市需要有本事的人来帮忙守护它的安全。

keys: Well, since you're asking... I could use some extra water!
en: Well, since you're asking... I could use some extra water!
zh: 好吧，既然你都问了……我确实需要一些额外的水！

keys: Well, sorry for keeping you. It gets boring standing out here all alone.
en: Well, sorry for keeping you. It gets boring standing out here all alone.
zh: 好吧，抱歉让你久等了。一个人站在这儿实在无聊。

keys: Were you able to communicate with it? Did it tell you what to do with that Kano?
en: Were you able to communicate with it? Did it tell you what to do with that Kano?
zh: 你能和它沟通吗？它有没有告诉你该怎么处理那颗卡诺？

keys: What do you need help with?
en: What do you need help with?
zh: 你需要什么帮助？

keys: What do you think?
en: What do you think?
zh: 你觉得呢？

keys: What remains of our purpose is keeping the knowledge of what they were. We study the flows and traces of Mana they left behind. We wait.
en: What remains of our purpose is keeping the knowledge of what they were. We study the flows and traces of Mana they left behind. We wait.
zh: 我们如今残存的使命，就是留住关于它们本来面目的知识。我们研究它们留下的魔力流转与痕迹。我们等待着。

keys: What were you doing wandering in the desert? It's been dangerous lately, you shouldn't go out there alone.
en: What were you doing wandering in the desert? It's been dangerous lately, you shouldn't go out there alone.
zh: 你在沙漠里晃荡什么呢？最近那里很危险，你不该一个人出去。

keys: What's next, you'll tell me the scorpions were breathing fire? Did a goblin sing you a song?
en: What's next, you'll tell me the scorpions were breathing fire? Did a goblin sing you a song?
zh: 下一步你是不是要告诉我蝎子会喷火？还是有个哥布林给你唱了首歌？

keys: What. He sent you here with these?
en: What. He sent you here with these?
zh: 什么。他让你带着这些东西来这儿？

keys: Whatever has been happening out in the desert has affected the maggots of the city as well.
en: Whatever has been happening out in the desert has affected the maggots of the city as well.
zh: 沙漠里发生的种种变故，也影响到了城里的蛆虫。

keys: Whatever you do, it won't be as bad as what the person you fought here would have done.
en: Whatever you do, it won't be as bad as what the person you fought here would have done.
zh: 无论你做过什么，都不会比你在这消灭的那个人曾经要做的事更糟糕。

keys: When active, they generate a protective aura, repelling Kaore-infected creatures and stabilizing the land.
en: When active, they generate a protective aura, repelling Kaore-infected creatures and stabilizing the land.
zh: 一旦激活，它们便会产生一层守护光环，驱离被卡奥尔感染的生物，并让大地重归安定。

keys: When it disrupted the lives of people for a time, a belief that it could be harmful developed.
en: When it disrupted the lives of people for a time, a belief that it could be harmful developed.
zh: 当它一度扰乱了人们的生活时，一种认为它可能有害的观念便滋生了。

keys: When people came to fear Mana, they cut them down. It spread fast. Some religious and politics gave it a doctrine and a purpose, and before long there were none left.
en: When people came to fear Mana, they cut them down. It spread fast. Some religious and politics gave it a doctrine and a purpose, and before long there were none left.
zh: 当人们开始畏惧魔力时，他们便把魔力树砍倒了。这股风潮蔓延得很快。一些宗教与政客将其变成了教义和旗号，不久之后，魔力树便一棵不剩了。

keys: When the Queen first stationed us together, we each set aside a share for the other. In case things got bad enough that one of us needed to get out.
en: When the Queen first stationed us together, we each set aside a share for the other. In case things got bad enough that one of us needed to get out.
zh: 女王当初把我们安排在一起时，我们各自都为对方留出了一份。以防万一情况糟到我们其中一人需要脱身的时候。

keys: When the Uru were threatened, a group of druids that intended to protect us planted a Kano here in this cave.
en: When the Uru were threatened, a group of druids that intended to protect us planted a Kano here in this cave.
zh: 当魔力树受到威胁时，一群想要保护我们的德鲁伊在这座洞穴里种下了一颗卡诺。

keys: When worn, it allows you to channel Mana, and to connect with Soul Menhirs.
en: When worn, it allows you to channel Mana, and to connect with Soul Menhirs.
zh: 戴上它，你就能引导魔力，并与灵魂石碑建立联结。

keys: When you level up you earn some new attribute points, you can spend them on attributes that match your play style and confirm your choice.
en: When you level up you earn some new attribute points, you can spend them on attributes that match your play style and confirm your choice.
zh: 升级后你会获得新的属性点，可以把它们分配给符合你玩法的属性，然后确认你的选择。

keys: When you touch a Soul Menhir while wearing a Zielite Amulet, the stone resonates with the Menhir's Zielite.
en: When you touch a Soul Menhir while wearing a Zielite Amulet, the stone resonates with the Menhir's Zielite.
zh: 当你佩戴着泽利石护身符触碰灵魂石碑时，这块石头便会与石碑中的泽利石产生共鸣。

keys: When you're ready to go, head to La Johanne's helm. There we can discuss where exactly you want to go.
en: When you're ready to go, head to La Johanne's helm. There we can discuss where exactly you want to go.
zh: 准备好出发时，就到拉·约翰娜号的船舵旁来。到时我们再商量你具体想去哪里。

keys: Whenever that has happened in the past they've fought us back until we gave up. I respect that about them, they have clear boundaries and will defend their homeland.
en: Whenever that has happened in the past they've fought us back until we gave up. I respect that about them, they have clear boundaries and will defend their homeland.
zh: 过去每次发生这种事，他们都会反击我们，直到我们放弃为止。我因此敬重他们，他们有清晰的底线，并且会捍卫自己的家园。

keys: Where did those letters go? Come back when you have them.
en: Where did those letters go? Come back when you have them.
zh: 那些信呢？拿到之后再回来找我。

keys: Where do you think you are going?
en: Where do you think you are going?
zh: 你这是要去哪儿？

keys: Who are you?
en: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

keys: Who are you? Please, I need your help!
en: Who are you? Please, I need your help!
zh: 你是谁？求求你，我需要帮助！

keys: Wie can't draw circles. When she tries they look like fat squares.
en: Wie can't draw circles. When she tries they look like fat squares.
zh: 薇画不好圆圈。她一画，圆就变成了胖乎乎的方块。

keys: With proper boots you will also move a lot faster than on your bare feet.
en: With proper boots you will also move a lot faster than on your bare feet.
zh: 穿上合适的靴子，你的移动速度也会比光着脚快得多。

keys: With the help of a Kahwe, a Soul Menhir can be used to heal those who are injured and even to prevent death in some cases, giving people multiple chances at life.
en: With the help of a Kahwe, a Soul Menhir can be used to heal those who are injured and even to prevent death in some cases, giving people multiple chances at life.
zh: 在卡维的协助下，灵魂石碑可以治愈伤者，甚至在某些情况下阻止死亡，让人们获得多次生命的机会。

keys: Yay, you're both here! Have fun!
en: Yay, you're both here! Have fun!
zh: 太好了，你们俩都来了！玩得开心！

keys: Yes! I make lots of Healing Potions for our guards and the people of this city. They're quick remedies for most ailments and really help keep our people safer.
en: Yes! I make lots of Healing Potions for our guards and the people of this city. They're quick remedies for most ailments and really help keep our people safer.
zh: 是的！我为我们的守卫和城里的民众酿制大量治疗药水。它们是应付大多数病痛的速效药，确实能让我们的民众更安全。

keys: Yes. He managed to convince the old dying king that he was his bastard son.
en: Yes. He managed to convince the old dying king that he was his bastard son.
zh: 是的。他设法让那位弥留的老国王相信了自己是他的私生子。

keys: Yes. I am an Uru, or a Mana Tree.
en: Yes. I am an Uru, or a Mana Tree.
zh: 是的。我就是一棵乌卢，一棵魔力树。

keys: You again. Corridors are open to you now, I meant that.
en: You again. Corridors are open to you now, I meant that.
zh: 又是你。现在走廊对你开放了，我说真的。

keys: You are already up?
en: You are already up?
zh: 你已经起床了？

keys: You are not supposed to be here. Neither am I, but that doesn't matter.
en: You are not supposed to be here. Neither am I, but that doesn't matter.
zh: 你不该出现在这里。我也不该，不过这不重要。

keys: You are stronger than I thought.
en: You are stronger than I thought.
zh: 你比我想象的要强。

keys: You brought enough for %d potions! How many should I brew?
en: You brought enough for %d potions! How many should I brew?
zh: 你带的材料够酿%d瓶药水了！你要我酿多少？

keys: You can also find the second largest library from the continent, it almost matches the number of books from the Manayir tower!
en: You can also find the second largest library from the continent, it almost matches the number of books from the Manayir tower!
zh: 这里还能找到大陆上第二大的图书馆，它的藏书几乎赶得上玛纳伊尔之塔了！

keys: You can also use the Target action to cycle target manually.
en: You can also use the Target action to cycle target manually.
zh: 你也可以使用锁定动作手动切换目标。

keys: You can drag and drop any usable items, skills or even emotes into the shortcut bar.
en: You can drag and drop any usable items, skills or even emotes into the shortcut bar.
zh: 你可以把任何可用的物品、技能甚至表情动作拖放到快捷栏里。

keys: You can find our old cactus fields and habitation outside these walls, they are completely uninhabited.
en: You can find our old cactus fields and habitation outside these walls, they are completely uninhabited.
zh: 在城墙外你能找到我们以前的仙人掌田和居所，如今那里已完全无人居住。

keys: You can find some of their traders in the marketplace north of here.
en: You can find some of their traders in the marketplace north of here.
zh: 你可以在北边的集市上找到他们的一些商人。

keys: You can follow that path to the north up to the city wall.
en: You can follow that path to the north up to the city wall.
zh: 你可以沿着那条向北的小路一直走到城墙。

keys: You can pinpoint any location on the map to move toward it in case you are lost.
en: You can pinpoint any location on the map to move toward it in case you are lost.
zh: 如果你迷路了，可以在地图上标记任意位置，朝它前进。

keys: You can request an audience to Her Majesty if you have something important to say but I wouldn't recommend to distract her from her gardens.
en: You can request an audience to Her Majesty if you have something important to say but I wouldn't recommend to distract her from her gardens.
zh: 如果你有要事，可以请求觐见女王陛下，不过我不建议你把她从她的花园里分神。

keys: You can see the number of monsters you got rid within the Manapedia tab of the menu bar.
en: You can see the number of monsters you got rid within the Manapedia tab of the menu bar.
zh: 你可以在菜单栏的魔典页签里查看你消灭了多少怪物。

keys: You can usually find them at the bakery stand in the market. I would go myself but, well... this Menhir will not guard itself.
en: You can usually find them at the bakery stand in the market. I would go myself but, well... this Menhir will not guard itself.
zh: 你通常可以在集市的面包摊找到他们。我本想自己去，可是……这石碑总得有人守着。

keys: You can't miss it, the city wall is almost visible from there!
en: You can't miss it, the city wall is almost visible from there!
zh: 你肯定能找到，从那儿几乎都能望见城墙了！

keys: You carry something.
en: You carry something.
zh: 你身上带着东西。

keys: You dip the jug into the pond. Hold still for a few seconds while it fills...
en: You dip the jug into the pond. Hold still for a few seconds while it fills...
zh: 你把水罐浸入池塘。保持不动，等它灌满……

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 1.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 1.
zh: 你在线索1的下方发现了一把钥匙。

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 2.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 2.
zh: 你在线索2的下方发现了一把钥匙。

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 3.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 3.
zh: 你在线索3的下方发现了一把钥匙。

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 4.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 4.
zh: 你在线索4的下方发现了一把钥匙。

keys: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 5.
en: You find a key hidden beneath the clue 5.
zh: 你在线索5的下方发现了一把钥匙。

keys: You find two old envelopes tucked between the dusty books.
en: You find two old envelopes tucked between the dusty books.
zh: 你在一本本落满灰尘的书之间发现了两封旧信。

keys: You found them. Good, good.
en: You found them. Good, good.
zh: 你找到了。好，很好。

keys: You haven't even got a weapon, have you?
en: You haven't even got a weapon, have you?
zh: 你连把武器都没有，对吧？

keys: You know what? We should just leave this place. Yes, let's just go.
en: You know what? We should just leave this place. Yes, let's just go.
zh: 你知道吗？我们应该离开这地方。对，我们这就走吧。

keys: You look like you want to say something. But your hands are empty.
en: You look like you want to say something. But your hands are empty.
zh: 你看起来像是有话要说。可你两手空空。

keys: You made it to the gates just in time. The guards found you on the ground, barely within sight.
en: You made it to the gates just in time. The guards found you on the ground, barely within sight.
zh: 你及时赶到了城门。守卫们发现你倒在沙地上，刚刚进入他们的视线。

keys: You made it! And with the water!
en: You made it! And with the water!
zh: 你做到了！还把水带回来了！

keys: You notice a crack in the cave wall. A faint blue light seems to come from the other side.
en: You notice a crack in the cave wall. A faint blue light seems to come from the other side.
zh: 你注意到洞穴墙壁上有一道裂缝。裂缝对面似乎透出微弱的蓝光。

keys: You place your hand on the Soul Menhir. The Zielite Amulet grows warm against your skin.
en: You place your hand on the Soul Menhir. The Zielite Amulet grows warm against your skin.
zh: 你把手放在灵魂石碑上。泽利石护身符在你的皮肤上渐渐变暖。

keys: You seem to be carrying a lot of stuff. Maybe get rid of some of that and come back.
en: You seem to be carrying a lot of stuff. Maybe get rid of some of that and come back.
zh: 你好像带了不少东西。也许先腾出一些空间再回来吧。

keys: You should be all set now.
en: You should be all set now.
zh: 你现在应该都准备好了。

keys: You should head back west and aim for the southern side of this valley.
en: You should head back west and aim for the southern side of this valley.
zh: 你应该折回西边，朝这片山谷的南侧前进。

keys: You should head south, then west. Their tower is past the sandstorm, on a quiet peninsula. Ask around in that area, someone should be able to point you in the right direction.
en: You should head south, then west. Their tower is past the sandstorm, on a quiet peninsula. Ask around in that area, someone should be able to point you in the right direction.
zh: 你应该先往南走，再往西。他们的塔就在沙暴之外一座安静的半岛上。在那片区域打听打听，应该有人能给你指路。

keys: You should report to Watchman Ekinu, near the gate where you met Elanore. Tell him I was happy with your work here.
en: You should report to Watchman Ekinu, near the gate where you met Elanore. Tell him I was happy with your work here.
zh: 你应该去向守卫埃基努报到，就在你遇到埃兰诺的那座城门附近。告诉他，我对你在干得这里很满意。

keys: You should speak to those who belong to his order. They will tell you who he is.
en: You should speak to those who belong to his order. They will tell you who he is.
zh: 你应该去和那些属于他教团的人谈谈。他们会告诉你他是谁。

keys: You should tell the guards inspecting the mines around here that you found great dangers and that it is not safe to access the lower levels.
en: You should tell the guards inspecting the mines around here that you found great dangers and that it is not safe to access the lower levels.
zh: 你应该告诉在这一带勘察矿井的守卫们，你发现了巨大的危险，下层不安全、无法进入。

keys: You spot the envelopes, but your bag is too full to carry them.
en: You spot the envelopes, but your bag is too full to carry them.
zh: 你看到了那些信，可你的背包太满，装不下它们。

keys: You took care of that very quickly and way better than I expected.
en: You took care of that very quickly and way better than I expected.
zh: 你处理得又快又好，远超我的预料。

keys: You watch as the water you carefully carried all the way here runs down his body and soaks into the sand below.
en: You watch as the water you carefully carried all the way here runs down his body and soaks into the sand below.
zh: 你眼睁睁看着自己一路小心翼翼带来的水顺着他全身流下，渗进脚下的沙子里。

keys: You will need every edge you can get to defeat what you will face in the desert.
en: You will need every edge you can get to defeat what you will face in the desert.
zh: 要战胜你在沙漠中将面对的一切，你需要抓住每一个可以争取的优势。

keys: You'll find them directly south of here.
en: You'll find them directly south of here.
zh: 你会在从这里的正南方向找到他们。

keys: You'll probably be running away at the first sight of a scorpion, won't you?
en: You'll probably be running away at the first sight of a scorpion, won't you?
zh: 你八成一看见蝎子就会落荒而逃吧？

keys: You're X! Pick a square, go go go!
en: You're X! Pick a square, go go go!
zh: 你是X！挑一个格子吧，快点快点！

keys: You're back!
en: You're back!
zh: 你回来了！

keys: You're back. What did he...
en: You're back. What did he...
zh: 你回来了。他是不是……

keys: You're going to be heading South, towards the Sandstorm Mines.
en: You're going to be heading South, towards the Sandstorm Mines.
zh: 你将一路南下，前往沙暴矿洞。

keys: You're not going to clear that field with your bare hands though.
en: You're not going to clear that field with your bare hands though.
zh: 不过光凭一双手，你可清整不了那块田地。

keys: You're right. I can't believe this. This is a Kano. A Mana Seed!
en: You're right. I can't believe this. This is a Kano. A Mana Seed!
zh: 你说得对。我不敢相信。这是一颗卡诺。一颗魔力种子！

keys: You're still alive.
en: You're still alive.
zh: 你还活着。

keys: You're the new one Ekinu took on? Good.
en: You're the new one Ekinu took on? Good.
zh: 你就是埃基努新收下的那个人？很好。

keys: You're the one Ekinu is sending down there?
en: You're the one Ekinu is sending down there?
zh: 你就是埃基努派下去的那个人？

keys: You've been lucky we found you before a goblin does but it's great to see you are doing better now.
en: You've been lucky we found you before a goblin does but it's great to see you are doing better now.
zh: 你运气好，是我们在哥布林之前发现了你，不过很高兴看到你恢复得不错。

keys: You've lost your mind. Whatever happened down there made you stupid!
en: You've lost your mind. Whatever happened down there made you stupid!
zh: 你疯了。下面发生的事把你变傻了！

keys: Your bag is fit to burst. How are you going to put glass in there? Go empty some stuff out!
en: Your bag is fit to burst. How are you going to put glass in there? Go empty some stuff out!
zh: 你的背包快撑爆了。玻璃要往哪儿放？先去倒掉一些东西！

keys: Your bag is too full to carry it. Make some room and come back to me.
en: Your bag is too full to carry it. Make some room and come back to me.
zh: 你的背包太满，装不下它。腾出点空间再来找我。

keys: Your bags are full, make some room first.
en: Your bags are full, make some room first.
zh: 你的背包满了，先腾出点空间。

keys: Your hand: %s
en: Your hand: %s
zh: 你的手牌：%s

keys: Your health bar shows how much damage you can take before dying.
en: Your health bar shows how much damage you can take before dying.
zh: 你的血条显示你在死亡之前还能承受多少伤害。

keys: Your job will be to scout the area and make sure the old cave system is clear of major dangers. If all is well, we will start bringing in miners and restart the whole operation.
en: Your job will be to scout the area and make sure the old cave system is clear of major dangers. If all is well, we will start bringing in miners and restart the whole operation.
zh: 你的任务是勘察那片区域，确保旧的洞穴系统没有重大危险。如果一切顺利，我们就会开始调来矿工，重新启动整个开采。

keys: Your mana powers your skills. Without it, many abilities become unavailable.
en: Your mana powers your skills. Without it, many abilities become unavailable.
zh: 魔力驱动着你的技能。没有魔力，许多能力将无法使用。

keys: Your map is your friend, do not hesitate to use it to know where you have to go.
en: Your map is your friend, do not hesitate to use it to know where you have to go.
zh: 地图是你的好帮手，想知道该去哪里时，尽管用它。

keys: Your part's done. Now we wait for your opponent...
en: Your part's done. Now we wait for your opponent...
zh: 你的部分已完成。现在我们等你的对手……

keys: Your score: %d%s
en: Your score: %d%s
zh: 你的得分：%d%s

keys: Your soul returns here instead of being lost.
en: Your soul returns here instead of being lost.
zh: 你的灵魂会回到这里，而不是消散无踪。

keys: Your voice is annoying. The last thing I need is to hear it echo through this cave.
en: Your voice is annoying. The last thing I need is to hear it echo through this cave.
zh: 你的声音真烦人。我最不需要的就是它在这个洞穴里回荡。

keys: Zielite craftsmanship still exists in hidden talismans, forgotten ruins, and the few remaining Soul Menhirs that continue to stand as bastions against Kaore.
en: Zielite craftsmanship still exists in hidden talismans, forgotten ruins, and the few remaining Soul Menhirs that continue to stand as bastions against Kaore.
zh: 泽利石的工艺仍然存在于隐秘的护符、被遗忘的遗迹，以及少数几座仍在矗立、对抗卡奥尔的堡垒般残存的灵魂石碑之中。

keys: Zielite is a rare mineral with a natural affinity for Mana. It can absorb, store, and emit Mana energy, making it invaluable for both magic and protection.
en: Zielite is a rare mineral with a natural affinity for Mana. It can absorb, store, and emit Mana energy, making it invaluable for both magic and protection.
zh: 泽利石是一种对魔力有天然亲和力的稀有矿物。它能够吸收、储存并释放魔力能量，因此无论在魔法还是防护方面都弥足珍贵。
